releases.title: Palmetto Publishing Releases New Sourced Collection of Presidential Quotations, Not My President
releases.body:
Newly published by Palmetto Publishing, the book gathers forty-eight verbatim quotations from Donald J. Trump, each followed by a footnote naming the speaker, the venue, and the date.

CHARLESTON, S.C., Oct. 29, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Palmetto Publishing has released Not My President, a compiled collection of presidential quotations drawn entirely from the public record. The book presents forty-eight numbered entries, one quotation apiece, each followed by a plain citation. The compiler adds no jokes and offers no analysis. The quotations are reproduced as delivered, with the speaker, occasion, city, and date attached.

The book opens on a signing ceremony. On July 10, 2019, at the signing of an executive order on advancing American kidney health in Washington, D.C., the sitting President said, "The kidney has a very special place in the heart." In Not My President the sentence appears exactly as spoken, the footnote arrives, and the page turns to the next entry. The sources span rally stages, Oval Office scrums, cabinet meetings, Twitter, a livestream, a town hall, and the deck of Air Force One, from a 1999 interview with the New York Times to remarks made deep into a second term.

The entries are grouped loosely by subject rather than chronology. Health care sits near testing and kidneys. Tariffs sit near inflation. Generals sit near the Civil War. Kim Jong-un sits near a stretch of North Korean beach described as a fine site for condominiums. Read in sequence across three decades of transcripts, the repetitions begin to look less like isolated gaffes and more like a method. What emerges is a portrait assembled out of the subject's own sentences.

The author stated, " My life has taught me the importance of being politically impartial. To objectively examine the policies proposed and implemented by our elected leaders. But most importantly to honestly examine the results of those policies. Today we see Americans divided politically, as if we are fans cheering for our favorite team to win. I spent years listening to how American institutions talk about themselves, and I came away with a sense of the distance between what gets said behind the podium and what gets put into practice. That widening gap is the inspiration for this book." 

The book is positioned for politically engaged adult readers who follow the news closely, prefer dry humor delivered without commentary, and want the primary sourcing that turns a punchline into a citation. It sits alongside quotation anthologies and documentary political humor rather than analysis or memoir, and arrives at a moment when claims about who said what, and when, circulate faster than the transcripts behind them. At roughly a quotation a page, it is built for browsing and for checking.

The author is a veteran of the Global War on Terror who was raised in New England by parents born in the Jim Crow South, a background the author credits for a long-standing interest in what official rhetoric can cost the people it describes.

Not My President is available for purchase online at Amazon.com and BarnesandNoble.com. For more information about the author, please visit www.notmypresident.net

About the Author: Before compiling a book of other people's words, the author spent years listening to how American institutions talk about themselves. A veteran of the Global War on Terror, the author came away from that service with a close, firsthand sense of the distance between what gets said at a podium and what gets carried out by the people under it. That gap is the subject of Not My President.

Raised in New England by parents born in the Jim Crow South, the author grew up with a generational memory of what official rhetoric can cost the people it describes. It is a lens that tends to make a person careful about sourcing. Every entry in Not My President: Dumb Things Said by the 45th and 47th President of the United States carries a date, a venue, and a speaker, and the compiler adds nothing else. The joke, such as it is, belongs entirely to the record.

The author describes the project as the work of an independent thinker rather than a partisan one, which in practice means a refusal to editorialize where a transcript will do. Rally remarks, Oval Office asides, cabinet meetings, a tweet at midnight: the quotations are gathered, numbered, footnoted, and left alone. Readers can draw their own conclusions.

releases.title: RÉMY MARTIN MARKS ITS DEBUT AS THE OFFICIAL COGNAC OF THE 2026 LATIN GRAMMY AWARDS®, CELEBRATING THE PEOPLE AND MILESTONES THAT DEFINE LATIN MUSIC
releases.body:
Through My Celebración and a collaboration with Colombian artist Kapo, Rémy Martin 

spotlights the personal stories and influences behind meaningful achievements in Latin culture

NEW YORK, Oct. 29, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Today, the House of Rémy Martin announces its debut as the Official Cognac of the 2026 Latin GRAMMY Awards®, marking a new partnership with the Latin Recording Academy® in recognition of excellence in Latin music.

Through Rémy Martin's My Celebración platform, the brand highlights the role music plays in marking life's milestones and honoring the people who help make them possible. Rooted in shared traditions and personal experiences, My Celebración invites everyone to celebrate their achievements and those who have been part of their journey.

Throughout Latin GRAMMY Week, Rémy Martin will bring My Celebración to life through signature 1738 Accord Royal cocktails and live experiences at some of the week's most anticipated events, including  

The Leading Ladies of Entertainment, The Best New Artist Showcase, The Person of the Year Gala, The Official 2026 Latin GRAMMY Awards® Ceremony, and The Official Latin GRAMMY Awards® After-Party, where Rémy Martin will serve as the presenting spirit sponsor.

"For generations, Rémy Martin has celebrated craftsmanship, creative expression, and the moments that matter most," said Tonia Mancino, Vice President of Luxury Brands, Rémy Cointreau Americas. "The Latin GRAMMY Awards represent such a meaningful moment in culture, as they recognize the talent and dedication behind some of Latin music's greatest achievements. As the Official Cognac, we're proud to bring Rémy Martin 1738 Accord Royal to this occasion, raising a glass to the artists shaping Latin music and the people who have supported them along the way."

As part of My Celebración, Rémy Martin is partnering with Colombian artist Kapo on an exclusive content series exploring the influences and experiences that have shaped his career. The collaboration will feature artist-led social content and a red-carpet interview with Kapo, bringing fans closer to the people and experiences that have shaped his success. TelevisaUnivision will amplify the campaign across its social platforms and ViX, with additional content extending the My Celebración story beyond the awards and through the end of the year.

"This journey to the Latin GRAMMY Awards has been a dream for me, but I know I didn't get here by myself. My family, friends, team and the fans who have connected with my music and believed in me from the beginning are all part of this moment," said Kapo. "Rémy Martin brings people together through celebration, recognizing not just the milestones we achieve, but the people and experiences that shape our journey. Being able to share this special moment with those who have supported me makes Latin GRAMMY Week even more meaningful."

Named after the royal privilege granted to the House in 1738 in recognition of its exceptional craftsmanship, Rémy Martin 1738 Accord Royal carries forward a legacy of recognizing extraordinary achievement and the dedication required to reach it. As the featured cognac of Rémy Martin's Latin GRAMMYs partnership, 1738 Accord Royal brings that heritage to a celebration of the artists shaping Latin music and the people who have supported their journeys.

The 27th Annual Latin GRAMMY Awards will air live on Univision on Thursday, November 12, 2026, from the MGM Grand Garden Arena in Las Vegas. To learn more about Rémy Martin and My Celebración, visit RemyMartin.com/En-US/My-Celebracion and follow @RemyMartin on social media.

ABOUT RÉMY MARTIN

Since 1724, the House of Rémy Martin has produced exceptional cognacs. A profound love of the land, a continuity of family ownership and a passionate commitment to excellence has sustained Rémy Martin for over three centuries. As a result of its masterful blends, generations of tradition in Cognac and multi award-winning achievements, it consistently appeals to the world's most discerning connoisseurs.

Rémy Martin specializes in Cognacs Fine Champagne, including Rémy Martin X.O, Rémy Martin Tercet, Rémy Martin 1738 Accord Royal, and Rémy Martin V.S.O.P. For additional information, visit www.RemyMartin.com.

ABOUT THE LATIN RECORDING ACADEMY

The Latin Recording Academy® is a nonprofit dedicated to nurturing, celebrating, honoring and elevating Latin music and its creators. Established as the global authority on Latin music, the membership-based organization composed of music professionals produces the annual Latin GRAMMY Awards®, The Biggest Night in Latin Music®, which honors excellence in the recording arts and sciences, in addition to providing educational and outreach programs for the music community through its Latin GRAMMY Cultural Foundation®. For more information, please visit LatinGRAMMY.com.

PLEASE DRINK RESPONSIBLY

releases.title: Epson to Make IAAPA Expo Debut, Showcasing Projection and Point-of-Sale Solutions for Attractions and Entertainment Venues
releases.body:
Epson to Demonstrate Technology that Can Transform Spaces and Enhance Guest Experiences

LOS ALAMITOS, Calif., Oct. 29, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- From immersive attractions to seamless guest interactions, technology is transforming the themed entertainment experience. For the first time, Epson announced it will exhibit at IAAPA Expo, the annual event for the global association for the attractions industry. Epson will showcase its powerful projection technology designed to create immersive experiences and transform spaces, along with point-of-sale (POS) solutions that streamline transactions and support guest-facing operation from Nov. 17-20 in Orlando, Florida, at booth W1149.

Epson makes IAAPA Expo debut with projection and POS solutions to transform attractions and enhance guest experiences.

"Projection is being used in new and creative ways, from dark rides and simulation-based attractions to games and theater experiences, bringing large-scale visuals and interactive environments to life," said Chris Teguh, product manager, Epson America. "The attractions industry is built around creativity, storytelling and memorable guest experiences, making IAAPA a natural opportunity for Epson to demonstrate how our technologies can help bring those experiences to life."

At IAAPA, Epson will demonstrate how its projection and POS technologies can support the guest experience, from creating immersive environments to facilitating everyday transactions. The booth will include:

  • Interactive Immersive Experience – Developed in collaboration with Float4, this interactive demonstration will combine Epson's high-brightness projection with motion-responsive digital content to create an immersive environment that reacts to guests in real time. The experience will showcase how projection, real-time content and interactivity can transform physical spaces into dynamic, engaging attractions. Powered by Epson's EB-PQ2220B projector, the installation will demonstrate the impact of 20,000 lumens,¹ 4K Crystal Motion technology² and 3-chip 3LCD technology for delivering bright, detailed and vibrant imagery at scale.



  • Guest Experience – Epson's POS solutions support operations and workflows across ticketing, concessions, retail and food service, receipt printing and other transaction-related information. Epson will showcase the power and versatility of its portfolio, from high-performance receipt and label printing to compact, mobile solutions with the OmniLink® TM-T88VII, TM-m50II, TM-L100 liner-free thermal label printer, TM-U220II kitchen printer and the Mobilink™ TM-P20II and TM-P80II portable wireless receipt printers. These solutions can help staff keep lines moving and serve guests efficiently during busy operating periods.

For additional information about Epson's large venue projectors, visit www.epson.com/largevenue. For more information about Epson's POS solutions for hospitality, visit www.epson.com/poshospitality.

About Epson

Epson is a technology innovation and engineering company whose philosophy of efficient, compact, and precise innovation enriches lives and helps create a better world. The company uses technology and engineering ability to implement real-world solutions in precision innovation, industrial and robotics, office and home printing, and visual and lifestyle.

Led by the Japan-based Seiko Epson Corporation, the worldwide Epson Group generates annual sales of more than JPY 1.4 trillion. corporate.epson/en/

Epson America, Inc., based in Los Alamitos, Calif., is Epson's regional headquarters for the U.S., Canada and Latin America. To learn more about Epson, please visit: epson.com. You may also connect with Epson America on Facebook (facebook.com/Epson), X (x.com/EpsonAmerica), YouTube (youtube.com/epsonamerica) and Instagram (instagram.com/EpsonAmerica).

releases.title: Havas Promotes W. Joe DeMiero to CEO, Havas North America, Creative & Media
releases.body:
Expanded Remit Strengthens Senior Leadership Across Havas Creative & Havas Media in a Priority Growth Market.

NEW YORK, Oct. 28, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Havas today announced the promotion of W. Joe DeMiero to CEO, Havas North America, Creative and Media, effective immediately. Reporting jointly to Donna Murphy, Global CEO of Havas Creative Network, and Peter Mears, Global CEO of Havas Media Network, DeMiero will provide senior leadership across both networks in North America, working with leadership to strengthen collaboration and help clients access the breadth of Havas' expertise.

As clients contend with accelerating change driven by AI, data proliferation, evolving consumer expectations, and increasingly interconnected business challenges, leaders are under growing pressure to improve competitiveness and deliver measurable business performance. Building on Havas' established Village approach and its Converged.AI operating model, DeMiero will focus on bringing together the right capabilities across creative, media, production, data and technology, customer experience, social and influencer, and public relations to address those challenges and support client growth.

DeMiero joined Havas Creative Network in May 2026 as Chief Client and Business Officer for North America. Prior to joining Havas, he served as Interim Chief Marketing Officer and subsequently Vice President of Marketing at Sam's Club, where he helped align creative, media, data, and technology investments around enterprise growth priorities. He previously spent more than two decades in senior agency leadership roles, including serving as U.S. CEO of UM and CEO of Publicis Groupe's Hawkeye, with a focus on business transformation, growth acceleration, and strategic client partnerships. 

Yannick Bolloré, Chairman and CEO of Havas, said:

"Clients today are navigating an increasingly complex business environment and are looking for partners who can help them identify growth opportunities, accelerate transformation, and create competitive advantage. Joe's experience on both the client and agency sides of the industry gives him a unique perspective on our clients' needs and how we can best support their ambitions, making him the ideal leader to further strengthen our client-centric approach in North America." 

DeMiero, CEO, Havas North America, Creative & Media, said:

"The strength of Havas has always been our ability to unite great talent around our clients' ambitions. This has led to exceptional growth in North America and strong business performance for Havas globally. Our opportunity now is to make that even easier, helping clients access the full power of the Village to unlock growth, accelerate decision-making, and create measurable business value." 

About Havas

Founded in 1835 in Paris, Havas is one of the world's largest global communications groups, with nearly 23,000 people in over 100 countries. With the ambition to help brands unlock Growth, Powered by Desire, Havas brings together creativity, media, technology and production capabilities to build strong, desirable brands that people genuinely want to engage with. Its integrated model is supported by Converged.AI, the Group's operating system that unifies data, technology and AI to deliver optimized, scalable marketing solutions across the full customer journey. AI-driven, fueled by human ingenuity, and grounded in the belief that desire drives both brand performance and business outcomes, Havas teams collaborate within Havas Villages worldwide to cultivate reputation, relevance and long‑term preference for clients. Havas is equally committed to its people, fostering inclusive, responsible and inspiring workplaces where talent can thrive, because desire also starts from within. Further information is available at www.havas.com.

releases.title: Guideline Expands Ad Intelligence with Digital Pricing Data, Shedding Light on Some of the Industry's Most Complex Media Channels
releases.body:
Expanded data coverage across programmatic direct, and retail media made available through Guideline's AI Agent and MCP Server technology

NEW YORK, Oct. 28, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Guideline, a global provider of ad intelligence and media plan management solutions, today announced six updates rolling out in Q4 of 2026 across two areas: agentic AI capabilities and expanded advertising data. The agentic updates bring U.S. digital pricing data to the Guideline AI Agent and Guideline Ad Intelligence MCP Server, giving clients access through Guideline's agent or their own AI tools. The data updates include a new Programmatic Direct view, retail media coverage in Canada, and market data enhancements that add Quick Serve Restaurant segments and align digital classifications across the U.S., U.K. and Canada.

Guideline agentic updates bring U.S. digital pricing data to Guideline AI Agent and Guideline Ad Intelligence MCP Server

"Clients want our data to fit the way they already work," said Steve Silvers, Chief Product Officer of Guideline. "This quarter's enhancements do that two ways. They put our pricing data wherever clients ask questions, and they organize spend the way the market actually buys."

U.S. digital pricing, in the AI Agent or clients' own AI tools

Clients can now ask Guideline's AI Agent, in natural language, what digital ads cost by publisher, ad type or programmatic marketplace and see both pricing and spend in a single response. They can also build custom dashboards and use advanced charting to modify dimensions, measures, filters and custom formulas beyond standard dashboard views.

The same data and natural-language querying are available through the Guideline Ad Intelligence MCP Server, introduced in July. Teams can query data and trends from ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Microsoft Copilot or their own agents with no file exports, giving them workflow-native access to U.S. digital pricing.

Programmatic Direct: a fuller view of programmatic spend

Many digital buys are placed directly with publishers but run through programmatic channels, such as private marketplace and programmatic guaranteed deals. Guideline is adding a Buy Channel view that splits U.S. spend and pricing three ways: Direct, Programmatic Direct and Third-Party. Clients get a complete programmatic total, CPM benchmarks by buy channel and a view of how spend shifts between channels over time. Media owners can see their Programmatic Direct share against their competitive set, and the AI Agent can answer how a buy was placed.

Quick Serve Restaurants by segment

Quick Serve Restaurants, the second-largest U.S. product subcategory at $4.5 billion a year, now splits into Burgers, Chicken and Other Quick Serve Restaurants. Pizza Eateries & Delivery remains its own separate subcategory.

Retail media in Canada

Canadian clients can now isolate retail media spend, one of the fastest-growing areas of digital advertising, on the same classification U.S. and U.K. clients use.

One digital classification across the U.S., U.K. and Canada

Digital subtype names in U.K. and Canadian data are updated to match industry standards and the U.S., covering all current and historical data. Clients who work across markets now read one scheme instead of reconciling three.

Availability

The enhancements roll out to eligible Guideline Ad Intelligence clients on the following dates. Access varies by subscription. Clients can contact their Guideline account team or visit www.guideline.ai.

releases.title: E! Entertainment Co-Founder Larry Namer Named Global Strategy Advisor to U.S. WEED CHANNEL
releases.body:
Veteran entertainment executive joins founder Shane Doull to advance global growth, programming strategy, and category-exclusive brand partnerships for the cannabis lifestyle television network.

LOS ANGELES, Oct. 28, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- USWC GROUP, INC. U.S. WEED CHANNEL (USWC) today announced the appointment of Larry Namer, co-founder of E! Entertainment Television, as Global Strategy Advisor.

Namer will work with founder Shane Doull to refine the company's global growth strategy, develop its brand-partnership proposition, and position USWC at the intersection of entertainment, cannabis culture, and mainstream consumer marketing.

"Cannabis culture is a starting point for a much broader conversation about entertainment, identity, community, and consumer behavior," said Namer. "The opportunity is not simply to put advertising around cannabis content. It is to build a credible media business that audiences value—and give the right brand partners a meaningful role in that growth."

The appointment comes as USWC advances the Cannabis Center for Advertising Transparency (C-CAT), its public trust initiative giving brands a distinctive role in the platform's development.

A Different Approach to Brand Participation

Rather than treating brands as advertisers buying impressions, USWC developed C-CAT around a more integrated partnership proposition. The initiative connects brand participation with content, audience engagement, and the platform's long-term development.

"Shane's strategic insight is to make category exclusivity part of the business model from the beginning," Namer said. "When the proposition is structured and executed properly, a brand has the opportunity to build a differentiated position—not simply buy another campaign competitors can replicate the following week."

C-CAT's initial outreach drew interest from 390 executives at 209 companies with $10 billion-plus in annual revenue. Its "one partner per category" model means a mega-brand can be 100% locked out by a smaller challenger.

"Size alone does not give a company ownership of an opportunity," Namer added. "A challenger that recognizes the potential and acts decisively may secure a position that a market leader can no longer access on the same terms."

Building for Scale and Credibility

"There's no better mentor I could get. Larry grew E! Entertainment and I get 4 decades of insight." said Doull. "Mega brands call Larry to know 'what's next in entertainment'. He advised Microsoft, brought Hollywood to Russia, and to China. When I shared U.S. WEED CHANNEL he became our Global Strategy Advisor."

"Media history rewards companies that recognize changing audiences before those audiences become an obvious line item in everyone's marketing plan," Namer said. "Our job now is to turn that recognition into a disciplined strategy, a credible audience proposition, and partnerships that make business sense."

Brand and Agency Inquiries

To discuss C-CAT participation and category availability, contact Shane Doull at (424) 777-8792, ext. 420, or book an introductory call at https://links.usweedchannel.com/widget/bookings/c-cat-participation.

About U.S. WEED CHANNEL

Founded by Shane Doull, U.S. WEED CHANNEL (usweedchannel.com) is a globally streaming cannabis lifestyle TV network, live in 182 countries and 5 languages on Roku, Fire TV, Apple TV, Android TV, iOS, Android, and the web. USWC holds three federally registered trademarks, with the first filed in January 2014. It holds approved business pages on Meta, X, TikTok, and more, and measures ad impressions through Google Ad Manager. Its Cannabis Center for Advertising Transparency (C-CAT) is the corporately defensible entry point for brands to reach the world's 256 million cannabis consumers (UNODC) with exclusivity.

About Larry Namer

Larry Namer is a media entrepreneur and co-founder of E! Entertainment Television. As Global Strategy Advisor to U.S. WEED CHANNEL, he advises on global positioning, business development, and brand-partnership strategy.

releases.title: CANADIAN OWNED TERAPRO CONSTRUCTION EXPANDS IN ONTARIO, BRINGING CASE EQUIPMENT AND LOCAL SERVICE TO MORE CONTRACTORS
releases.body:
New Waterloo Region location provides Southwestern Ontario contractors with greater access to heavy equipment, parts and responsive local service.

WATERLOO, ON, Oct. 28, 2026 /CNW/ -- Canadian family-owned TERAPRO Construction is expanding its presence in Ontario with a new location in Waterloo Region, helping local contractors, municipalities and fleet operators manage equipment costs and minimize jobsite downtime.

TERAPRO Construction has grown into a major dealer network serving Quebec and Ontario, combining the resources of a large organization with the personal relationships and responsive support of a local dealership.

"Every hour a machine is out of service affects crews, schedules and the bottom line," said (Tyler Allinghanm, Waterloo Branch Manager), TERAPRO Construction. "Our Ontario expansion brings local support, parts and technical expertise closer to the contractors who rely on us every day."

Supporting Ontario's construction industry

As an authorized CASE Construction dealer, the Waterloo location offers new, used and rental equipment--including excavators, wheel loaders, compact track loaders and backhoes--alongside preventive maintenance, repair services and precision technology expertise.

Investing in local relationships and expertise

The new product is designed to make commercial auto coverage faster, more accessible, and more competitively priced for businesses that depend on their vehicles every day.

From contractors traveling between job sites to service fleets operating across multiple locations, commercial vehicles are essential to millions of American businesses. Yet securing insurance can be a slow and complicated process, particularly for small businesses that need coverage quickly to keep their operations running.

Corgi Business Auto aims to change that by combining modern underwriting technology with data-driven risk assessment to simplify how businesses obtain commercial auto insurance.

The initial rollout will focus on contractors and service fleets, with additional business classes to be introduced over time. Corgi plans to expand Business Auto into a broader product suite designed around the evolving insurance needs of businesses that operate commercial vehicles.

By incorporating driving behavior and other relevant risk indicators into its underwriting process, Corgi aims to more accurately assess risk, offer competitive pricing to safer drivers, and help businesses manage their insurance costs.

"Contractors and service businesses keep this country running, but getting their vehicles insured shouldn't slow them down," said Drew Bregman, President of Corgi Transportation. By using data and telematics to better understand how people actually drive, we can price risk more accurately and reward good drivers. releases.title: Oracle Introduces Oracle Media Fabric
releases.body:
Integrated platform brings together AI-powered production, enterprise media models, and distributed video delivery to help media companies, streaming providers, and brands get more value from their content

LAS VEGAS, Oct. 27, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Oracle AI World -- Oracle today announced Oracle Media Fabric, an integrated platform designed to help media companies, streaming providers, and brands reduce content production time and cost, distribute and stream high-quality video at scale, and create more personalized experiences for viewers. The platform brings sophisticated content creation and streaming capabilities once available only to the largest proprietary streaming platforms to content creators of all sizes. By connecting AI-powered creative tools with next-generation video delivery infrastructure built around open standards, Oracle Media Fabric enables audience-specific advertising, tailored programming, and shared viewing experiences built around what audiences care about.

"Creating content and delivering it to viewers were separate processes," said Clay Magouyrk, CEO, Oracle. "With Oracle Media Fabric, we're bringing content creation and streaming together, using AI across the entire production and distribution workflow. That helps creators reduce production time and cost, make better use of their existing content, and tailor viewing experiences for different audiences in real-time."

Oracle Media Fabric brings together Oracle Creative Studio, Oracle AI Media Models, and Oracle Video Edge to help customers create, adapt, and deliver content. It includes safeguards to help protect customers' intellectual property (IP) and reduce the risk of generated content infringing the IP rights of others. Powered by the Oracle Creative Studio and Oracle Video Edge, the Oracle Adaptive Media Platform connects creation and delivery to enable audience-specific advertising, personalized programming, and shared viewing experiences.

  • Oracle Creative Studio: Helps professional media teams and a broad range of creators turn ideas into storyboards, scenes, cinematic video, visual effects, and virtual characters. As an AI-powered production suite, it brings together Oracle AI Media Models and leading third-party models through a flexible, model-agnostic platform that can select models for each creative task based on requirements for security, provenance, cost, and IP protection.
  • Oracle AI Media Models: Help media studios and entertainment companies accelerate content creation while maintaining creative control. The Oracle-developed models focus on video generation, image generation, and image editing, enabling governed, large-scale media processing, intelligent curation and search, and frontier-model customization on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI).
  • Oracle Video Edge: Helps broadcasters and streaming providers maintain high video quality and low latency during large-scale live events, helping ensure viewer playback starts fast and remains smooth as audience sizes peak. The AI-enabled managed platform uses real-time network and playback information to coordinate capacity and direct viewers to suitable delivery locations across OCI and participating content delivery networks and internet service provider networks.
  • Oracle Adaptive Media Platform: Helps connect creation and delivery, enabling customers to develop audience-specific advertising, personalized programming, and shared viewing experiences. Brands can generate variations of a base advertisement within brand guidelines and approval rules, helping reduce the time and cost of creating multiple versions.

By helping broadcasters and streaming providers understand how audiences respond to programming and advertising, Oracle Media Fabric can inform more engaging experiences, strengthen viewer relationships within customers' applications, and create new opportunities to monetize content. Oracle Media Fabric is planned to be available within the next 12 months.

BEVERLY HILLS, Calif., Oct. 27, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Evolve Media has acquired CafeMom, LittleThings and MamásLatinas, expanding its presence in parenting and lifestyle media.

Evolve Media acquires CafeMom, LittleThings and MamásLatinas, expanding its portfolio of trusted editorial brands.

The brands add trusted editorial destinations and over 40 million combined social media followers. The acquisition creates opportunities to connect with audiences through publications, social media and creator-led content.

"CafeMom, LittleThings and MamásLatinas are iconic digital media properties we've admired for years. Each has built a strong relationship with its audience. Together, they deepen Evolve's connection with moms and families," said Aaron Broder, founder and CEO of Evolve Media. "We're excited to build on that trust with Evolve's broader media capabilities, creating more ways for marketers to connect with these audiences through content and communities they care about."

Each brand brings a distinct voice and audience to Evolve's portfolio:

  • CafeMom provides parents with relatable perspectives, useful information, entertainment and community throughout every stage of motherhood.
  • MamásLatinas delivers culturally relevant parenting, lifestyle and entertainment content for bilingual and bicultural Latina mothers and families.
  • LittleThings shares uplifting lifestyle and human-interest stories designed to inform, inspire and bring people together.

The acquisition advances Evolve's Publisher+ approach, building on established publishing brands and extending their content across social media, video, podcasts and creator partnerships.

CafeMom, LittleThings and MamásLatinas join TotallyKidz and pet brands DogTime and CatTime, helping Evolve connect with families across the moments that shape their lives.

The three brands previously belonged to Wild Sky Media, a digital media company owned by Bright Mountain Technologies. Bright Mountain sold them to Evolve as it shifted its strategic focus to its audience intelligence platform.

"Evolve has been a valued partner to Bright Mountain, collaborating to offer advertising opportunities that reach and engage family audiences. We're glad to see CafeMom, LittleThings and MamásLatinas joining a team we know well," said Matthew Drinkwater, CEO of Bright Mountain.

Evolve plans to build on the strengths of CafeMom, LittleThings and MamásLatinas through added editorial investment while preserving each brand's distinct voice and relationship with its audience.

About Evolve Media

Evolve Media is a digital media company connecting brands with audiences through publishing, original content, social media, video, podcasts, gaming and creator-led campaigns. Founded in 1999, Evolve has a portfolio spanning entertainment, sports, lifestyle and family media, including TotallyKidz, its kids and parenting offering.

Learn more at www.evolvemediallc.com or follow Evolve Media on LinkedIn.

About Bright Mountain Technologies

Bright Mountain Technologies (OTCMKTS: BMTM) develops decision intelligence products for the marketing ecosystem, with audience intelligence as the currency that connects research, creative, and media. It is the parent company of Big Village, Deep Focus, and Bright Mountain Media.

Together, these companies inform Brightstream, the company's AI-native audience intelligence platform. Brightstream connects Big Village's research-based audience insights directly to creative and media, so the audience a brand reaches is the one it intended to reach. Learn more at brightmountain.ai.

LOS ANGELES, Oct. 27, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- What exactly does a storyboard artist do? Tony Liberatore—the master visual storyteller behind some of the most iconic action sequences in Black Panther, Captain America: The Winter Soldier, The Eternals, and the Fast & Furious franchise - breaks down the essential framework of visual storytelling with two upcoming guides and more.

Arcturus Publishing and Simon & Schuster will release his debut books, The Fast Cars Coloring Book (November 2026) and How to Create Storyboards for Action (January 2027).

Both are available for pre-order now.

These books are part of a larger effort by Liberatore to share filmmaking techniques and support new artists. This is both altruistic and practical, especially during the current downturn in entertainment industry jobs.

A self-made talent who bypassed traditional film school to become a three-time Art Directors Guild nominee and winner, Liberatore actively mentors emerging visual storytellers. In tandem with the books, he hosts The Action Lab—a free weekly masterclass on Discord where he breaks down iconic action scenes shot-by-shot—alongside instructional videos on his YouTube channel and dedicated portfolio insights at bigscreenboards.com.

The two upcoming titles offer distinct entry points into his dynamic cinematic world:

  • The Fast Cars Coloring Book (Releasing November 2026): Features 45 high-octane, storyboard-inspired illustrations of Hollywood's most iconic vehicles and set-pieces, allowing automotive enthusiasts and film buffs to color the action themselves.
  • How to Create Storyboards for Action (Releasing January 2027): A comprehensive, graphic novel-style industry guide. It features an exclusive foreword by Oscar-winning director Ryan Coogler. The book reveals how a director's primary visual blueprint dictates every moving part of a massive production—from cinematography and stunt choreography to final editing.

Packed with granular career advice, technical industry tips, and spectacular behind-the-scenes artwork, Liberatore's upcoming releases are essential text for film fans, comic lovers, and future filmmakers looking to master a digital-age craft.

To view the collection and pre-order, visit the official Arcturus Publishing Collection: https://arcturuspublishing.com/collections/tony-liberatore

Tony Liberatore is an award-winning storyboard artist with over two decades of experience in blockbuster film and advertising. releases.title: AbbVie Submits Biologics License Application (BLA) for Etentamig to U.S. FDA for Adults Living With Relapsed/Refractory Multiple Myeloma
releases.body:
–  Etentamig is a second-generation BCMA-directed bispecific antibody T-cell engager with a clinical profile and dosing schedule that can potentially support treatment across a broad range of settings, including in community-based care

–  In the Phase 3 CERVINO study, etentamig achieved statistically significant improvements in overall response rate (ORR) and progression-free survival (PFS) versus investigator's choice of standard available therapies

–  Submission underscores AbbVie's ambition to advance a broad multiple myeloma portfolio that addresses disease complexity and supports patients' evolving care goals 

NORTH CHICAGO, Ill., Oct. 27, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- AbbVie (NYSE: ABBV) today announced the submission of a Biologics License Application (BLA) to the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) for etentamig, a second-generation BCMA x CD3 bispecific antibody T-cell engager administered intravenously for the treatment of adults with relapsed or refractory multiple myeloma.1

BCMA-directed bispecific antibodies and CAR-T therapies have significantly changed the treatment landscape for people living with multiple myeloma.2 However, their broader adoption may be limited by adverse events such as cytokine release syndrome, infections or neurotoxicity, as well as specialized administration and monitoring requirements.2,3,4 Additionally, as disease relapses, treatment options in later lines of therapy become increasingly limited. Together, these factors highlight the need for additional therapies that may address the biology of the disease and help support effective treatment delivery across diverse care environments.2,3,4

"Multiple myeloma is a chronic blood cancer that can reshape a person's life. Patients deserve therapeutic options that are not only effective, but also support the realities of when, where and how they receive treatment," said Daejin Abidoye, M.D., vice president and therapeutic area head, oncology, solid tumor and hematology, AbbVie. "This milestone brings us a step closer to potentially delivering a novel, patient-centered treatment option with a manageable safety profile and the convenience of a monthly dosing schedule that can help meet the needs of people living with multiple myeloma wherever they receive care."

The submission is supported by results from the global, Phase 3, multicenter, randomized CERVINO study evaluating etentamig versus investigator's choice of standard available therapies (SAT) in patients with triple-class exposed relapsed or refractory multiple myeloma who had received at least two prior lines of therapy.5 Topline results were announced earlier this year.

  • The findings indicated that etentamig achieved statistically significant improvements across the dual primary endpoints of overall response rate (74.0% vs. 45.7%) and progression-free survival (60% risk reduction) versus SAT.5
  • The most common treatment-emergent adverse events (TEAEs) reported in the etentamig arm of the study (≥ 25%) included cytokine release syndrome (CRS), hypogammaglobulinemia, neutropenia and anemia.5
    • Discontinuations related to TEAEs were low for etentamig vs. SAT (3.6% vs. 14%).5
  • With monthly dosing from initiation, etentamig demonstrated a potentially differentiated safety profile.5
    • Among patients receiving a single step-up dose, the incidence of CRS was low (28.3%), all being grade 1 (23.9%) or grade 2 (4.4%) and no grade 3 or higher events were reported.5 One patient experienced an immune effector cell-associated neurotoxicity syndrome (ICANS) event (grade 1).
    • Among all etentamig patients, grade 3/4 infections occurred in 27.7% versus 19.2% in patients receiving SAT.5 Importantly, grade 5 infections were observed less frequently in patients treated with etentamig (1.5%) versus SAT (3.1%).

About Multiple Myeloma

Multiple myeloma is a chronic blood cancer that affects white blood cells, called plasma cells, in the bone marrow.6 It causes these cells to grow and crowd out healthy cells that help fight infection.6 In 2025, an estimated 36,000 people were diagnosed with multiple myeloma in the U.S.7 The disease commonly presents with non-specific symptoms that may resemble other conditions, leading to delays in diagnosis and treatment.8 People living with multiple myeloma and their caregivers often face substantial physical, emotional and economic burden.9

About the Phase 3 CERVINO Study5

The Phase 3 CERVINO trial (NCT06158841) is a global, multicenter, randomized, open-label study evaluating etentamig versus investigator's choice of standard available therapies (SAT) in triple-class exposed patients with relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma (RRMM) who have received at least two prior lines of therapy, including exposure to a proteasome inhibitor, an immunomodulatory drug and an anti-CD38 monoclonal antibody. A total of 393 patients were randomized 1:1 to receive etentamig or SAT, including carfilzomib plus dexamethasone, elotuzumab plus pomalidomide and dexamethasone, or selinexor plus bortezomib and dexamethasone. Etentamig was administered using an optimized dosing strategy that incorporates a single step-up dose followed by monthly (Q4W) dosing from initiation.



The dual primary endpoints are overall response rate and progression-free survival. Key secondary endpoints include overall survival, depth of response, measurable residual disease (MRD) negativity, disease symptoms and physical functioning.

About Etentamig

Etentamig (ABBV-383) is an investigational, second-generation BCMA x CD3 bispecific antibody T-cell engager designed to combine meaningful anti-myeloma activity with a differentiated treatment experience for patients. Etentamig is composed of a low-affinity CD3 binding domain, designed to reduce cytokine release syndrome and infections, a high-affinity bivalent BCMA-binding domain, and retained FcRn binding enabling Q4W dosing after a single step-up dose. The direct connection between these structural findings and clinical effects is currently being investigated.10

BCMA is highly expressed on the surface of malignant plasma cells in multiple myeloma, making it a key target for therapy. BCMA plays a crucial role in the survival of myeloma cells by promoting their growth and inhibiting their apoptosis (programmed cell death).11

Several clinical studies are evaluating the potential of etentamig across diverse patient populations and treatment settings. To learn more about AbbVie's ongoing etentamig clinical trials, please visit clinicaltrials.gov.

releases.title: Earlytrade and Palmer Consulting Group Partner to Bring Early Payments to General Contractors Using CMiC
releases.body:
Palmer becomes Earlytrade's preferred CMiC advisory, integration and implementation partner; both companies exhibiting at CMiC CONNECT 2026, Nov. 1–4 in Orlando

DENVER and LISLE, Ill., Oct. 27, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Earlytrade, the construction fintech company whose marketplace negotiates early payment terms between general contractors and subcontractors, and Palmer Consulting Group, a construction-focused business transformation and technology advisory firm, today announced a strategic integration partnership. Palmer becomes Earlytrade's preferred CMiC integration and implementation partner and will offer Earlytrade to its CMiC clients as its recommended early payment provider.

General contractors using CMiC, including Palmer's existing clients, can now connect to Earlytrade, with implementation typically taking six to eight weeks. Palmer configures the integration to each GC's CMiC environment, and guides implementation and adoption. Initial deployments are focused on CMiC on-premise and PaaS environments, with CMiC Cloud capabilities planned as part of the joint partnership roadmap. Finance teams keep their current accounting workflows, and approved subcontractor invoices become available for early payment.

"For a GC using CMiC, the question isn't whether a tool is valuable. It's whether it will work inside their environment," said Dave Anderskow, President of Palmer Consulting Group. "Our clients want solutions that deliver value without disrupting their operations. Because Palmer knows the CMiC ecosystem so well, we can typically have the Earlytrade integration configured and delivering value in weeks, with a team our clients already know and trust."

"Financially stable subcontractors mean less risk on every project," said Guy Saxelby, CEO and co-founder of Earlytrade. "Earlytrade lets GCs using CMiC strengthen their supply chain and earn margin on cash that would otherwise sit idle. With Palmer, they can do it in the CMiC environment they already run."

Power Construction, a general contractor that uses CMiC, runs Earlytrade across all of its projects. Since launch, Power and its trade partners have participated in millions of dollars of early payment opportunities, helping improve cash flow across projects while generating significant benefits for both parties.

"Earlytrade represents a win-win opportunity for both Power and our trade partners," said Brian Herold, VP of Finance at Power Construction. "The system provides transparency into invoice status, offers subcontractors the choice to receive payment earlier, and delivers greater certainty regarding payment timing. These benefits strengthen subcontractor liquidity and financial stability while improving the project's working capital efficiency and creating an attractive yield on available cash."

Earlytrade is not factoring, supply chain finance or lending: general contractors fund early payments from their own working capital. Earlytrade has negotiated more than $3 billion in early payments globally.

Meet both teams at CMiC CONNECT 2026

Earlytrade and Palmer will both exhibit at CONNECT 2026, CMiC's annual customer conference, November 1–4 in Orlando, Florida. 

Joint webinar for CMiC users

After CONNECT, Earlytrade and Palmer will co-host an introductory webinar for CMiC users, including current Palmer clients, on Thursday, November 19, 2026, at 9 am PT / 12 pm ET. Register at https://bit.ly/4siGbWz.

About Earlytrade

Earlytrade is a global fintech company transforming how construction and enterprise businesses grow margin and turn finance operations into a profit center. Operating across Australia, New Zealand, the United States, Canada, Ireland, and the United Kingdom, Earlytrade's suite of solutions, including early payment and progress claim platforms, empowers general contractors and trade partners to improve cash flow, increase profitability, and build more resilient supply chains. Learn more at earlytrade.com.

About Palmer Consulting Group

Founded in 2009 and based in Lisle, Illinois, Palmer Consulting Group helps construction companies build better businesses through strategy, technology, data and operational transformation. Palmer partners with contractors to align leadership, optimize processes, modernize technology platforms, and improve business performance across finance, operations, and project execution. Its services span business transformation, technology advisory, ERP consulting, systems integration, data and AI solutions, managed services, and ongoing application support. By combining deep construction industry expertise with practical execution, Palmer helps clients navigate change and achieve measurable business outcomes. Learn more at palmercg.com.

releases.title: PopTake joins Stamina Group's media network through strategic partnership with View the VIBE
releases.body:
Hosted by Hugo Filipe and Mikael Melo, the Canadian pop culture podcast enters a new chapter as "PopTake, powered by View the VIBE," with ambitions to reach audiences across Canada and beyond.

TORONTO, Oct. 26, 2026 /CNW/ -- Canadian pop culture podcast PopTake, hosted by Hugo Filipe and Mikael Melo, has officially joined Stamina Group's media network through a strategic partnership with View the VIBE. The collaboration brings together two entertainment-focused platforms with a shared passion for culture, community and storytelling, with plans to expand PopTake's reach nationally and explore international distribution opportunities.

Now operating as "PopTake, powered by View the VIBE." Your hot takes on music, pop culture and life. The show will benefit from the publication's established Canadian audience, editorial platform and industry/distribution relationships while maintaining the independent voice and creative chemistry that have become its signature.

The partnership also builds on Stamina Group's experience bringing Canadian-produced content to international audiences. Through its globally distributed video podcast Gents Talk, which has secured placement on airline entertainment systems worldwide and through other transportation syndication partners, Stamina Group has established relationships it hopes to leverage to introduce PopTake to audiences beyond Canada.

"Building Stamina Group has always been about amplifying creative voices and connecting audiences through meaningful content," says Steven Branco, Founder & Chief Creative Officer, Stamina Group Inc. and Editor-in-Chief, View the VIBE. "With PopTake's focus on pop culture and View the VIBE's roots in community, culture and entertainment, the partnership felt like a natural fit. Hugo and Mikael have built something special, and we're excited to help take it further. Building on the international success of Gent's Talk and our global distribution partnerships, we see an opportunity to bring PopTake to audiences across Canada and around the world."

Two best friends, plenty of hot takes

Launched in April 2025, PopTake is a weekly entertainment podcast covering music, film, television, celebrity culture and life. Hosted by longtime friends Hugo Filipe and Mikael Melo, the show combines candid commentary, celebrity interviews and social-first content with the energy of a group chat.

Now in its second season, PopTake has built a growing presence on Canada's entertainment circuit, covering major events including TIFF, the JUNO Awards, the Canadian Screen Awards and Osheaga. Its celebrity interviews have featured the likes of Zara Larsson, Katy Perry, Chloe Bailey, JADE, Perrie Edwards, FLO, Sofi Tukker, Patrick J. Adams, Eric McCormack, Lauren Ash, Simple Plan and Holly Humberstone, and more.

The show also features recognizable segments including Backtrack, where artists identify their songs played backwards; This or That, a rapid-fire celebrity interview format where artists must choose between their own songs; and HotTake or FlopTake, featuring the hosts' weekly pop culture verdicts.

"PopTake started as two best friends who couldn't stop talking about pop culture, so we hit record," says Hugo Filipe, Co-Founder & Co-Host, PopTake. "Partnering with View the VIBE puts our takes in front of an audience that loves this stuff, as much as we do."



"We strike the balance between professional and fanboy," adds Mikael Melo, Co-Founder & Co-Host, PopTake . "Our podcast feels like your two internet besties gushing over your favourite artists, and every now and then, we get to interview them. Asking the questions fans actually want answered."

Beyond the podcast, both hosts bring established entertainment and creative industry experience.

Hugo Filipe is a Toronto-based creative director, photographer and entrepreneur. He leads Mister Mister, a creative studio with clients including H&M, RBC, OVO and Campbell's, and owns Nosso Studio, which operates two creative spaces in Toronto.

Mikael Melo is a Canadian Screen Award-winning producer, reporter and digital creator whose credits include ET Canada, Big Brother Canada and The Social. He has interviewed international stars including Katy Perry, Olivia Rodrigo and Florence Pugh, and collaborated with brands including Paramount+, Samsung, Sony Pictures and Universal Music Canada.

What's next for PopTake?

Through the partnership, PopTake will continue producing its weekly podcast and signature social-first content, while exploring expanded editorial collaborations, new sponsors, celebrity interviews, event coverage, branded entertainment opportunities, in-person events and new distribution channels.

The addition of PopTake further strengthens Stamina Group's growing portfolio of International media properties, which includes View the VIBE, WanderEater, Gent's Post and the internationally distributed and acclaimed video podcast, Gent's Talk.

NOTE TO EDITORS

High-resolution photos and more are available here, including portraits, hero imagery, BTS, logo files and more. Please credit PopTake/Stamina Group accordingly.

About PopTake

PopTake is a Canadian pop culture and entertainment podcast hosted by best friends Hugo Filipe and Mikael Melo. Every week, the pair deliver fresh perspectives and unfiltered hot takes on the biggest stories in music, film, TV and celebrity culture. Beyond the weekly episode, PopTake has built a reputation for social first interviews and red carpet coverage, from the JUNO Awards and the Canadian Screen Awards to TIFF and Osheaga, with signature segments like Backtrack, This or That and HotTake or FlopTake. PopTake brings the energy of a group chat to the biggest names in pop. PopTake is powered by View the VIBE, part of the Stamina Group media network.

For more, visit PopTake on YouTube, Apple Podcasts, Spotify, Instagram, TikTok and everywhere you stream your podcasts or PopTakePodcast.com.

About View the VIBE

Established in 2010, View the VIBE is a leading Canadian digital lifestyle and entertainment publication delivering fresh, engaging and culturally relevant content. Known for its fun, edgy and informative approach to storytelling, the platform covers food, hospitality, fashion, entertainment, pop culture and lifestyle through original editorial, video, social storytelling and live experiences. For over 15 years, View the VIBE has connected audiences with the people, places, trends and cultural conversations shaping Toronto, Canada and beyond. Proudly owned and operated by Stamina Group Inc., View the VIBE continues to deliver its signature perspective on culture, community and, of course, the best VIBES.

For more, visit ViewtheVIBE.com.

About Stamina Group Inc.

Stamina Group Inc. (STAMINA) is a privately owned Canadian media, communications and creative production company specializing in award-winning digital-first content, original storytelling and unique brand experiences. Founded and led by award-winning creative multihyphenate and on-air lifestyle expert Steven Branco, STAMINA owns, operates or partners with a growing network of Canadian media brands and platforms, including View the VIBE, WanderEater, Gent's Post, the globally streamed video podcast Gent's Talk, and PopTake. Through its creative production arm, STAMINA produces original editorial photography, video and branded content internationally, with work produced for and/or featured in leading global publications including Flaunt, FASHION, HELLO!, VULKAN, SWAGGER, GQ, The Perfect Man, Condé Nast Traveler, Travel + Leisure and Architectural Digest, among others.

For more, visit HaveStamina.com.

releases.title: Teen Warrior's Abduction Launches an Odyssey Across Alien Worlds
releases.body:
LaMont Schiers' debut science fiction novel explores survival, discovery and perseverance in the first book of a planned seven-book series.

CENTERVILLE, Utah, Oct. 26, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- When a 14-year-old warrior is abducted from his home planet and forced to work as a miner on a distant world, survival becomes only the beginning of his journey. "Pii's Odyssey: The Eternals," debut novelist LaMont Schiers launches a science fiction adventure that follows young Pii as he encounters unfamiliar civilizations, alien beings and advanced technology, he must hold onto the hope of finding his way home.

The first installment in a planned seven-book series, "Pii's Odyssey: The Eternals" explores perseverance, patience and the choices people make when circumstances are beyond their control. As Pii navigates an unfamiliar universe, he must learn to recognize opportunities that could change the course of his future.

"Life is challenging and oftentimes beyond our control, but what defines us is our ability to overcome by exercising the patience to wait for those windows of opportunity, and when they do, step through without reservation," Schiers said.

The idea for the series began with a vivid dream Schiers had in 2017. The resulting story explores space travel, the possibility of countless inhabited worlds and how adversity can shape a person's future. The novel is intended for readers of various ages, including young readers and fans of science fiction.

"Pii's Odyssey"

By LaMont Schiers 

ISBN: 9781665798624 (softcover); 9781665798631 (electronic) 

Available at Archway Publishing, Amazon and Barnes & Noble 

About the author

Born in Teton Valley, Idaho, LaMont Schiers has lived across the United States as well as in Germany. His professional background spans mechanical engineering, manufacturing and higher education, where he advanced to vice president of finance and administration at a college in Arizona. He holds a BFA in Industrial Design from BYU and a MS in Organizational Management from Keuka College. An outdoor enthusiast and father of four, Schiers is developing the next installment in the "Pii's Odyssey" series.

releases.title: Lionsgate and Steven Paul's SP Media Launch New Joint Venture
releases.body:
SP Media Has Made a Significant Capital Investment to Co-invest into New Businesses that Expand Lionsgate's Global Platform

 Deal Includes Partnership on Independent Feature Film Production and Extends Resources toward the Continuing Diversification of 3 Arts and Other Lionsgate Businesses

SANTA MONICA, Calif., Oct. 26, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Lionsgate (NYSE: LION) and SP Media, led by longtime producer, financier and entrepreneur Steven Paul, today announced the formation of a joint venture through which SP Media will make a significant capital investment to co-invest in new ventures that expand and grow the Lionsgate platform as well as extending resources toward the continuing diversification of 3 Arts and other Lionsgate businesses. SP Media will also produce independent feature films that Lionsgate will distribute.

The relationship will be managed through a joint venture majority owned and controlled by Lionsgate.

The agreement allows Lionsgate to continue scaling its content platform with a new source of independent feature films. The collaboration allows SP Media to partner with one of the world's leading independent standalone studios, and it gives SP a world-class distributor for its films.

Paul, the chairman, founder and CEO of Crystal Sky Pictures and SP Media Group, has shepherded a number of commercial box office successes including the Baby Geniuses franchise, Ghost Rider and Ghost Rider 2: Spirit of Vengeance, starring Nicolas Cage, Ghost in the Shell, starring Scarlett Johansson, and the Lionsgate-distributed Rambo: Last Blood.

"Steven is a savvy & experienced entrepreneur who has a longstanding relationship with our studio, and I'm pleased to partner with him across multiple touchpoints of our business," said Lionsgate CEO Jon Feltheimer. "He recognizes the unique and valuable assets that we have built and his investment will help drive the continued growth of these businesses."

"Lionsgate is one of the most dynamic and entrepreneurial content studios in the media space today," said Paul. "I'm delighted to build on my longstanding relationship with Jon Feltheimer and the Lionsgate leadership team as we grow our businesses together in an industry environment filled with opportunity."

The deal was negotiated for Lionsgate by COO Brian Goldsmith, EVP & General Counsel Bruce Tobey, and Senior VP Corporate Development Suzy Felfeli and for SP Media by SP Media Group President & COO Scott Karol. Moelis served as financial advisor to Lionsgate and Lazard served as financial advisor to SP Media. Paul Hastings LLP represented SP Media on the deal. 

About Lionsgate

Lionsgate (NYSE: LION) is one of the world's leading standalone, pure play content companies. It brings together diversified motion picture and television production and distribution businesses, a world-class portfolio of valuable brands and franchises, a premier talent management and production powerhouse at 3 Arts Entertainment and a more than 20,000-title film and television library, all driven by Lionsgate's bold and entrepreneurial culture.

About Steven Paul and the SP Group of Companies

Steven Paul is an entrepreneur, producer and financier of motion pictures and television, and his SP Group of Companies has holdings in media, entertainment, talent representation, technology, hospitality, banking and real estate. The diverse portfolio includes The Samuel Goldwyn Building in Century City and Casa Marella Boutique Hotel in South Beach Miami, JLTV television network, Atlas Comics (founded by Marvel Comics owner Martin Goodman), Avenue Six Studios in Van Nuys California, Echo Bridge Distribution Company and Hanks Café in Century City.

releases.title: POLARIS SIGNS OFF-ROAD CHAMPION KYLE CHANEY TO MULTI-YEAR RACING AGREEMENT WITH RZR FACTORY RACING
releases.body:
Multi-Discipline Champion Joins RZR Factory Racing, Featuring King of the Hammers and Select U.S. Off-Road Races

MINNEAPOLIS, Oct. 26, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Polaris and RZR Factory Racing today announced a multi-year agreement with championship-winning off-road racer Kyle Chaney, adding one of the sport's most versatile competitors to the team's driver lineup. Chaney will pilot a Polaris RZR Pro R Factory at King of the Hammers and select premier U.S. off-road races.

The addition of Chaney further strengthens an already formidable roster, positioning RZR Factory Racing to build on its success and raise the bar even higher. The team has firmly established itself as a dominant force in North American desert racing, capturing three consecutive UTV Open championships in the SCORE World Desert Championship in Baja while claiming victories at the sport's most prestigious events, including the Baja 1000, Baja 500, Baja 400, San Felipe 250, Mint 400, King of the Hammers and Vegas to Reno. This remarkable run of success has solidified Polaris RZR Factory Racing's reputation as the most dominant team in off-road racing.

"Kyle is a decorated off-road racer and his relentless desire to win makes him an incredible addition to RZR Factory Racing," said Alex Scheuerell, Polaris' Director of Off-Road Motorsports. "Our factory racing program has always been about pushing the limits of what's possible with the RZR Pro R Factory, and Kyle shares the same mentality. This is a long-term commitment that extends beyond adding another great driver. Kyle's experience across so many forms of racing will be invaluable to our team moving forward." 

Chaney's championship résumé includes two GNCC championships, three short-course championships and four-consecutive UTV King of the Hammers victories. In 2025, he added an overall King of the Hammers Race of Kings victory, becoming the first driver to win the premier 4400 Unlimited race in a UTV-based vehicle.

"I'm incredibly excited to join Polaris and RZR Factory Racing," said Chaney. "I've competed against them for years, so I know the level they operate and the drive they have to compete and win each and every race. When the opportunity presented itself, it was a no-brainer to be a part of the program they're building."  

This marks the beginning of a new chapter, allowing Polaris and Chaney to pursue marquee victories across different terrain and racing environments. Additional details of his race schedule will be announced at a later date.

To learn more, please visit Polaris.com/RZR or join the conversation and follow on Facebook sm, Instagram sm, YouTube sm and Xsm.

About Polaris

As the global leader in powersports, Polaris Inc. (NYSE: PII) has been defining and redefining outdoor adventure since 1954. Polaris delivers industry-shaping off-road vehicles, snowmobiles, boats, military, quadricycles, and commercial transportation vehicles, along with an expansive portfolio of parts, garments, and accessories. Its lineup includes some of the most iconic brands in powersports including the RANGER, RZR, Polaris XPEDITION, Bennington pontoons, Slingshot, and more. Headquartered in Minnesota and serving customers in nearly 100 countries, Polaris continues to set the standard for performance, quality, and unmatched service. Explore more at www.polaris.com.

releases.title: Most Requested Jeep® Gladiator Upgrade Arrives Straight From the Factory for the First Time: Meet the New 2027 35-inch Tire Launch Edition
releases.body:
AUBURN HILLS, Mich., October 26, 2026 /PRNewswire/ --

  • Jeep® Gladiator customers can now order factory-installed 35-inch tires on Willys, Rubicon and Rubicon X models
  • Limited-production launch edition pairs enhanced off-road capability with exclusive bronze-accented design on America's only open-air pickup
  • New factory-installed 35-inch tire package expands Gladiator capability and gives customers a turnkey solution engineered for the vehicle
  • 35-inch Tire Package enhances Trail Rated capability with increased ground clearance and improved approach, breakover and departure angles

Jeep® brand raises the bar for off-road capability and customer choice with the introduction of the new 2027 Jeep Gladiator 35-inch Tire Launch Edition, a limited-production model that delivers one of the most requested upgrades among Gladiator owners directly from the factory.

Available across Gladiator Willys, Rubicon and Rubicon X models, the Launch Edition combines factory-installed 35-inch all-terrain tires, exclusive bronze-accented styling and distinctive graphics to create a bold new expression of Jeep capability.

"Gladiator customers continue to personalize their vehicles to tackle bigger adventures, and 35-inch tires have consistently been one of the most popular modifications," said Branden Coté, Jeep CEO. "The Gladiator 35-inch Tire Launch Edition gives customers the capability, confidence and distinctive look they want straight from the factory, backed by the quality and engineering expected from the Jeep brand."

Built for capability

The Gladiator 35-inch Tire Launch Edition enhances the truck's legendary off-road credentials with factory-installed 35-inch tires on distinctive bronze-painted beadlock-capable wheels, adding ground clearance, ground presence and an even more aggressive stance.

The factory-engineered 35-inch Tire Package further enhances Gladiator's Trail Rated capability with 12.9 inches of ground clearance and improved approach, breakover and departure angles of 46.7, 23.3 and 26.7 degrees, respectively. A 1-inch factory suspension lift, 4.56 final-drive ratio, heavy-duty Dana axles and performance brakes work together with 35-inch all-terrain tires to deliver added obstacle clearance, low-speed control and confidence across challenging terrain, while highline fender flares, wheel-flare extensions and 17-inch beadlock-capable wheels complete the integrated package.

Available for a limited production run, the package reinforces Jeep Gladiator's leadership in the midsize pickup segment by combining proven Jeep capability with customer-driven content.

Distinctive design

Each Gladiator 35-inch Tire Launch Edition features a unique collection of exterior enhancements, including:

  • Factory-installed 35-inch all-terrain tires
  • 35-inch Suspension Package
  • Performance brakes
  • 4.56 final drive ratio
  • Full-time 4:1 transfer case
  • Heavy-duty Dana axles
  • Highline fender flares
  • Wheel flare extensions
  • 1-inch factory lift
  • Performance hood (exclusive to specific models)
  • Bronze-painted, 17-inch beadlock wheels
  • Bronze Jeep badging and accents
  • Exclusive hood, side and tailgate graphics
  • Bronze tow hooks
  • Model-specific Launch Edition design elements

Rubicon and Rubicon X models add additional hood and vent graphics, while the Rubicon X Package features an exclusive side-door graphic and Jeep performance hood with unique hood decal.

Limited availability

The 2027 Jeep Gladiator 35-inch Tire Launch Edition is now available to order in North America. Production will be limited, offering enthusiasts the opportunity to own a highly distinctive Gladiator that celebrates the capability, customization and adventure at the heart of the Jeep brand.

Jeep Brand

For 85 years, Jeep has been a global leader in SUVs, delivering legendary off-road capability, advanced technology and exceptional versatility for those who seek fun and adventure. With a commitment to innovation, the Jeep brand offers a diverse lineup of vehicles powered by internal combustion engines, hybrid technology and all-electric drivetrains. Built on a heritage of freedom, adventure, authenticity and passion, Jeep continues to set the standard for rugged and refined vehicles designed to conquer it all.

releases.title: Unifying Spirits, Producer of Boba POPS®, Appoints David Li, PhD, to Lead Expansion into Functional Nutrition
releases.body:
New Director of Research and Development will develop popping boba that delivers protein, caffeine, and fiber, extending the patented pearl technology behind Boba POPS®, the world's first alcohol-filled popping boba, beyond beverage alcohol and into some of the fastest-growing categories in food and beverage.

PITTSBURGH, Oct. 26, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Unifying Spirits, creator of Boba POPS®, is proud to announce the appointment of David Li, PhD, as Director of Research and Development. Li will lead the company's research and development, including a long-term initiative to turn its popping boba into a delivery system for protein, caffeine, and dietary fiber, an expansion sparked by the success of Boba POPS®.

Li brings a rare combination of laboratory science and commercial strategy. He earned his PhD in Biological and Biomedical Sciences from Washington University School of Medicine in St. Louis and holds dual bachelor's degrees in Mathematical Economics and Biochemistry from Wake Forest University, where he graduated cum laude and was named Graduate of the Year by the Department of Mathematical Economics. For four years, he advised life sciences companies with The Biotechnology and Life Sciences Advising (BALSA) Group, rising to Director of Marketing and leading teams that sized markets, mapped competitors, and built growth strategies for clients in cell therapy, medical devices, surgical imaging, and manufacturing. He also served as an associate with Oracle's Life Sciences Solutions group.

"Boba POPS® proved that a popping pearl can carry so much more than flavor, and David is the person who will show the world just how much more," said Harmon Rozycki, COO of Unifying Spirits. "Protein, caffeine, and fiber are things millions of people reach for every single day. We believe our pearls belong right there with them, and this is the beginning of a much bigger Unifying Spirits."

"Good science and good business don't always live under the same roof," said Li. "At Unifying Spirits, they do, and that made joining an easy decision. I've spent my career working between the two, from biochemistry and PhD research to helping life sciences companies build their growth strategies. Boba POPS® gives me a proven, patented product to build on, and I'm excited to take it far beyond the cocktail glass."

Boba POPS® is the catalyst for this expansion. What began as a way for consumers and bartenders to add bursts of flavored spirits to their drinks is now sold in more than 6,000 retail doors across 45 states and has grown into the new Pop & Go™ RTD cocktail line. Along the way, Unifying Spirits developed and patented the fill process that keeps its popping pearls shelf-stable in finished drinks, and that same technology is what makes a functional line possible. Pearls built to carry spirits can be engineered to carry functional ingredients.

The new pipeline targets three of the fastest-growing corners of food and beverage. Protein-filled pearls, engineered to hold their structure, will serve fitness- and wellness-focused consumers in a high-protein RTD category projected to grow about 10% annually through 2033. Caffeinated pearls will bring an energy boost to the brand's existing flavors and colors, opening the door to a caffeinated beverage market estimated at $92 billion in 2026. And fiber- and probiotic-enriched pearls will tap into surging demand for gut health, a category whose momentum was underscored by PepsiCo's $1.95 billion acquisition of Poppi in 2025.

Experimentation on the functional lines began this quarter. Li is already making his mark on the core Boba POPS® portfolio as well with new technology that keeps differently flavored pearls distinct in a single drink, laying the groundwork for what comes next.

About Boba POPS®

Boba POPS® (Pearls Of Popping Spirits) are the first and only alcohol-filled popping boba, delivering a sensory-driven way to enjoy spirits. Available in Blueberry, Strawberry, Raspberry, Peach, Lychee, Espresso, Margarita, Piña Colada, and Pumpkin Spice Style, in 50 ml and 375 ml formats, the brand is sold in more than 6,000 retail doors across 34 states, including ABC Fine Wine & Spirits, Kroger, and Albertsons. Learn more at bobapops.com.

About Unifying Spirits

Unifying Spirits is an innovation-driven beverage company that develops and scales differentiated products in the spirits industry. Led by a management team with a track record of building and exiting high-value beverage brands, the company pairs patented manufacturing processes with purpose-built U.S. production facilities. Unifying Spirits is the creator and sole producer of Boba POPS®. Learn more at unifyingspirits.com.
