releases.title: Ovintiv Announces Agreement to Acquire Montney Oil Producer, Logan Energy Corp.
releases.body:
Transaction Unlocks Incremental Profitability, Provides Additional Oil Growth Optionality, and Adds to Premium Return Drilling Inventory

Highlights:

  • Agreement reached to acquire Logan Energy Corp. for C$1.40 per share in cash for total consideration of approximately $890 million (C$1.26 billion) including the assumption of Net Debt
  • Ovintiv's shareholder returns plan is unchanged – targeting 2026 shareholder returns of at least 60% of Non-GAAP Free Cash Flow
  • Acquisition is expected to add approximately 266,000 net acres and approximately 20 thousand barrels of oil equivalent per day ("MBOE/d") in the oil-rich window of the Montney
  • Montney-only inventory additions of approximately 420 total net 10,000-foot equivalent oil well locations, including approximately 220 premium(1) return well locations at an average cost of $1.5 million per premium location(2) and approximately 200 upside locations
  • Includes ownership of two new oil batteries and interests in two natural gas processing facilities which are expected to enhance Montney margins and enable future oil growth optionality
  • Transaction is expected to be immediately and long-term accretive across all key financial metrics including Non-GAAP Cash Flow per Share accretion of approximately 5% in 2027
  • Annual cost synergies expected to total approximately $60 million

DENVER, Oct. 26, 2026 /CNW/ -- Ovintiv Inc. (NYSE: OVV) (TSX: OVV) ("Ovintiv" or the "Company") and Logan Energy Corp. ("Logan") (TSXV: LGN) today announced that they have entered into a definitive agreement whereby Ovintiv will acquire all of the outstanding shares of Logan in an all-cash transaction that values Logan at approximately $890 million (C$1.26 billion) including expected Net Debt at closing. The acquisition is expected to add approximately 420 total net 10,000-foot equivalent oil well locations, and approximately 266,000 net acres (approximately 200,000 core acres, 80% undeveloped) in the Montney oil window. Current production from the acquired assets is approximately 20 MBOE/d (approximately 7 thousand barrels per day ("Mbbls/d") of oil and condensate, 70 million cubic feet per day ("MMcf/d") of natural gas and 1 Mbbls/d of other NGLs (C2 to C4)). The assets are located in close proximity to Ovintiv's existing Montney operations and include two new oil batteries and additional natural gas processing capacity.

"This bolt-on transaction delivers value for our shareholders by adding high margin oil and condensate production and infrastructure, utilizing our operational advantage to drive significant synergies, and adding to our already deep drilling inventory and future growth optionality," said Ovintiv President and CEO, Brendan McCracken. "The Logan assets have demonstrated leading oil productivity performance and will immediately compete for capital alongside the rest of our portfolio."

The transaction is expected to be funded through a combination of the Company's cash on hand, borrowings under its credit facility and its commercial paper program.

1)

Premium return well locations defined as generating a greater than 35% internal rate of return at $55/bbl WTI oil and $2.75/MMBtu NYMEX natural gas prices.

2)

Assumes PDP value of $27,500/BOE/d.

Transaction Overview:

  • Immediately Accretive – The transaction is expected to be immediately and long-term accretive across key operational and financial metrics including Non-GAAP Cash Flow per Share of 5%, and Non-GAAP Free Cash Flow per Share of 3% in 2027.
  • Increases Montney Scale – The transaction is expected to add approximately 420 total net 10,000-foot equivalent oil well locations (220 premium return locations and approximately 200 upside locations, all located in the Simonette and Pouce Coupe areas). Ovintiv's core land position in the Montney is expected to increase to approximately 720,000 net acres. Also included in the transaction is approximately 60,000 net acres with exposure to the Duvernay shale. A map of Ovintiv's pro forma acreage is available on its website at: https://investor.ovintiv.com/image/OVV+Pro+Forma+Montney+Map.pdf.
  • Significant Synergies – The transaction is expected to generate cost synergies of approximately $60 million annually, comprised primarily of capital savings, production cost savings and overhead cost reductions. Capital cost savings are estimated at more than $2 million per well across the acquired assets, consistent with Ovintiv's current Montney well costs.
  • Infrastructure Ownership – Logan has 100% ownership in two new oil batteries in Simonette with combined capacity of 24 Mbbls/d, the first of which came online during the third quarter of 2026, and the second is expected to come online by the end of the first quarter of 2027. Logan also has 50% ownership at a natural gas processing facility in Simonette with total capacity of 90 MMcf/d and 65% ownership in a natural gas processing facility in Pouce Coupe with total capacity of 57 MMcf/d. Ownership in these facilities is expected to enhance Ovintiv's Montney margins and provide future growth optionality.
  • Maintains Strong Balance Sheet – Following closing of the transaction early in the first quarter of 2027, Ovintiv expects its Net Debt to be below $4 billion. The Company's targeted shareholder returns remain unchanged with at least 60% of 2026 Non-GAAP Free Cash Flow expected to be returned to shareholders via share buybacks and regular dividend payments. Beyond 2026, the target range remains unchanged at 50% to 100%.

Refer to Note 1 for information regarding Non-GAAP Measures in this release.

As part of the transaction, 100% of the shares of Logan Oil Corp., a newly formed wholly owned subsidiary of Logan, will be spun out to the shareholders of Logan and will include select Logan assets outside the Montney and Duvernay fairways. More details specific to Logan Oil Corp. can be found on Logan's website.

Timing and Approvals

The transaction has been unanimously approved by the Boards of Directors of both Ovintiv and Logan and is expected to close early in the first quarter of 2027, subject to the receipt of Logan shareholder, court and regulatory approvals and the satisfaction of other customary closing conditions.

Advisors

RBC Capital Markets is serving as exclusive financial advisor to Ovintiv on the transaction. Blake, Cassels & Graydon LLP and Paul, Weiss, Rifkind, Wharton & Garrison LLP are serving as legal advisors to Ovintiv on the transaction.

Important information

Unless otherwise noted, Ovintiv reports in U.S. dollars and production and sales estimates are reported on an after-royalties basis. Unless otherwise specified or the context otherwise requires, references to Ovintiv or to the Company includes reference to subsidiaries of and partnership interests held by Ovintiv Inc. and its subsidiaries.

NI 51-101 Exemption

The Canadian securities regulatory authorities have issued a decision document (the "Decision") granting Ovintiv exemptive relief from the requirements contained in Canada's National Instrument 51-101 Standards of Disclosure for Oil and Gas Activities ("NI 51-101"). As a result of the Decision, and provided that certain conditions set out in the Decision are met on an on-going basis, Ovintiv will not be required to comply with the Canadian requirements of NI 51-101 and the Canadian Oil and Gas Evaluation Handbook. The Decision permits Ovintiv to provide disclosure in respect of its oil and gas activities in the form permitted by, and in accordance with, the legal requirements imposed by the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission ("SEC"), the Securities Act of 1933, the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, the Sarbanes-Oxley Act of 2002 and the rules of the NYSE. The Decision also provides that Ovintiv is required to file all such oil and gas disclosures with the Canadian securities regulatory authorities on www.sedarplus.ca as soon as practicable after such disclosure is filed with the SEC.

NOTE 1: Non-GAAP Measures

Certain measures in this news release do not have any standardized meaning as prescribed by U.S. GAAP and, therefore, are considered non-GAAP measures. These measures may not be comparable to similar measures presented by other companies and should not be viewed as a substitute for measures reported under U.S. GAAP. These measures are commonly used in the oil and gas industry and/or by Ovintiv to provide shareholders and potential investors with additional information regarding the Company's liquidity and its ability to generate funds to finance its operations. For additional information regarding non-GAAP measures, see the Company's website. This news release contains references to non-GAAP measures as follows:

  • Non-GAAP Cash Flow and Non-GAAP Cash Flow per Share are non-GAAP measures. Non-GAAP Cash Flow is defined as cash from (used in) operating activities excluding net change in other assets and liabilities, and net change in non-cash working capital. Non-GAAP Cash Flow per Share is Non-GAAP Cash Flow divided by the weighted average number of shares of common stock outstanding.
  • Non-GAAP Free Cash Flow and Non-GAAP Free Cash Flow per Share are non-GAAP measures. Non-GAAP Free Cash Flow is defined as Non-GAAP Cash Flow in excess of capital expenditures, excluding net acquisitions and divestitures. Non-GAAP Free Cash Flow per Share is Non-GAAP Free Cash Flow divided by the weighted average number of shares of common stock outstanding. Forecasted Non-GAAP Cash Flow and forecasted Non-GAAP Free Cash Flow assume strip pricing as of October 20, 2026. Due to their forward-looking nature, management cannot reliably predict certain of the necessary components of the most directly comparable forward-looking GAAP measures, such as changes in operating assets and liabilities. Accordingly, Ovintiv is unable to present quantitative reconciliations of such forward-looking non-GAAP financial measures to their most directly comparable forward-looking GAAP financial measures. Amounts excluded from these non-GAAP measures in future periods could be significant.
  • Net Debt is a non-GAAP measure defined as long-term debt, including the current portion, less cash and cash equivalents.

ADVISORY REGARDING OIL AND GAS INFORMATION – The conversion of natural gas volumes to barrels of oil equivalent ("BOE") is on the basis of six thousand cubic feet to one barrel. BOE is based on a generic energy equivalency conversion method primarily applicable at the burner tip and does not represent economic value equivalency at the wellhead. Readers are cautioned that BOE may be misleading, particularly if used in isolation. The term "liquids" is used to represent oil, NGLs and condensate. The term "condensate" refers to plant condensate.

releases.body:
Allegedly, Sinclair Television of California, LLC failed to provide employees with  accurate itemized wage statements due to missed meal breaks. This, allegedly, has resulted in violations of various California Labor codes.

**THIS IS AN ATTORNEY ADVERTISEMENT**

SHASTA, Calif., Oct. 25, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- The Sacramento employment law attorneys, at Blumenthal Nordrehaug Bhowmik De Blouw LLP, filed a class action complaint alleging that Sinclair Television of California, LLC violated the California Labor Code. The Sinclair Television of California,  LLC class action lawsuit, Case No. 211799, is currently pending in the Shasta County Superior Court of the State of California. A copy of the Complaint can be read here.

According to California Labor Law, companies are required to pay employees for all time worked, meaning the time during which an employee is subject to the control of an employer, including all the time the employees are permitted or suffered to permit this work. Allegedly, Defendant required their employees to work off the clock without paying them for all the time they were under Defendant's control. To the extent that the time worked off the clock does not qualify for overtime premium payment, Defendant, allegedly, failed to pay minimum wages for the time worked off-the-clock in violation of Cal. Lab. Code §§ 1194,1197, and 1197.1 

California Labor Code § 226 provides that every employer shall furnish each of his or her employees with an accurate itemized wage statement. According to the Complaint, Plaintiff was paid on an hourly basis. Therefore, Plaintiff's wage statements should reflect all applicable pay periods in which the wages were earned pursuant to  Cal. Lab. Code section 226 (a). Allegedly, the wage statements Defendant provided to Plaintiff failed to identify such information.

For more information about the class action lawsuit against Sinclair Television of California, LLC, call (800) 568-8020 to speak to an experienced California employment attorney today.

releases.title: Marketplace Awarded Nasdaq Foundation Grant to Expand Financial Literacy Programming
releases.body:
SAINT PAUL, Minn., Oct. 22, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- American Public Media's Marketplace has been awarded a grant from the Nasdaq Foundation's Economic Opportunity Grant Program to expand financial literacy programming. Marketplace is the most widely consumed business and economic news program in the country across radio and television, commercial or public broadcasting.

The grant will support financial literacy programs across Marketplace, contributing to its mission to raise economic intelligence. The Economic Opportunity Grant will be used to help package some of Marketplace's strongest reporting and learning content into an accessible digital hub. This project will help lower barriers to financial literacy tools by expanding classroom-ready resources through education partners and engaging audiences within their communities and online, especially on social media.

The initiative is anchored by four of Marketplace's established financial literacy podcasts: Million Bazillion, Financially Inclined, This Is Uncomfortable and Must Be the Money. Together, these shows help listeners at every stage of life understand how finance, business and the economy work — knowledge that can serve them for a lifetime.

"Financial literacy is at the core of our mission to raise the economic intelligence of the nation," said Neal Scarbrough, Vice President and General Manager of Marketplace. "With support from the Nasdaq Foundation, Marketplace can accelerate its efforts to expand the depth, discoverability and reach of this content, empowering Americans at every stage of life with the tools to build stronger financial futures."

"Financial literacy is the foundation of economic opportunity. Through our Economic Opportunity Grant Program, the Nasdaq Foundation is committed to democratizing financial knowledge and equipping under-resourced communities with the tools to share in the wealth that markets create. Marketplace's mission to raise the economic intelligence of the country aligns powerfully with that goal, and we're proud to support their work in making trusted, accessible financial education available to more Americans," said Jailan Griffiths, President of the Nasdaq Foundation and Head of Purpose at Nasdaq.

To learn more about the Nasdaq Foundation's Economic Opportunity Grant Program, visit www.nasdaq.com/nasdaq-foundation. To see Marketplace's full suite of shows, visit marketplace.org.

About Marketplace

Marketplace® is on a mission to raise the economic intelligence of the country. Its core programs — Marketplace®, Marketplace Morning Report® and Marketplace Tech® — are currently broadcast nationwide on more than 800 public radio stations and heard by over 10 million weekly listeners. Marketplace podcasts, including This Is Uncomfortable and Million Bazillion, can be found at marketplace.org or on your favorite podcast app. The Marketplace portfolio of programs are produced and distributed by American Public Media® (APM), one of the largest producers and distributors of public radio programming in the world. For more information on Marketplace, visit marketplace.org, or like us on Facebook.

About the Nasdaq Foundation

The Nasdaq Foundation works to support under-resourced communities by reimagining investor engagement and equipping communities with the financial knowledge needed to share in the wealth that markets create. Through strategic partnerships and grantmaking, the Foundation supports innovative solutions that empower under-resourced communities and foster long-term economic resilience.

releases.title: HEARST MEDIA PRODUCTION GROUP RENEWS HOME FOR GOOD FOR SECOND SEASON ON ABC STATIONS NATIONWIDE
releases.body:
Season 2 Premieres Weekend Mornings Starting Saturday, January 9

NEW YORK, Oct. 22, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Hearst Media Production Group (HMPG), in partnership with Kidde, and producer Epic Entertainment and Media Group, today announced the renewal of Home for Good for a second season. Following a successful first season that brought home-and-life safety education to viewers nationwide, the series will return to ABC stations nationwide on Saturday, January 9 as part of the "Weekend Adventure" educational/informational (E/I) programming block.

Hosted by Art Edmonds, Home for Good is a home renovation series honoring people who make a difference in their communities.  Each half-hour episode transforms a room or personal space to better serve people who dedicate their lives to helping others. Season 2 will continue to feature first responders while bringing more community champions and service workers into the spotlight, including educators, mentors and volunteers who serve families in need.

The new season will feature people whose work takes many forms, including a firefighter supporting families of children with autism, a teacher whose students bring comfort to young cancer patients, a volunteer who provides food and supplies to people experiencing homelessness, and a mentor who created a free life-skills program for local youth.

The show will also continue its partnership with series' sponsor Kidde, North America's #1 home fire safety brand1.  Season 2 will combine inspiring stories of community service with practical home- and life-safety education, helping viewers identify everyday risks and take action to better protect the people, pets and homes they care about most.

 "For more than 100 years, Kidde has helped families protect what matters most," said Isis Wu, president of Kidde's Global Residential Fire & Safety business. "Through Home for Good, we're able to celebrate people who strengthen their communities while helping families better understand the fire, carbon monoxide and other safety risks they may face at home. By combining inspiring stories with practical education, we're empowering people to take simple steps that can help make every home a safer home."

"We're excited to bring Home for Good back for a second season," said Bryan Curb, president of HMPG. "The series shows what giving back looks like through the people who serve their communities, while giving viewers practical fire and CO safety information they can use at home. That combination reflects the value of E/I programming: stories that educate, inform and offer a meaningful benefit to audiences."

HMPG's current program portfolio comprises more than 30 original series and hundreds of hours of content annually on leading broadcast networks and station groups and on connected TV and streaming platforms. It has a library of 85 series (6,000 episodes) and its content can be found in 100 countries.

About Kidde

Kidde, a leading manufacturer of residential smoke alarms, carbon monoxide alarms, fire extinguishers, and safety accessories, has been helping to keep the world a safer place for over 100 years. Kidde produced the first integrated smoke detection system a century ago and continues its legacy today by delivering advanced fire-safety technology. Kidde is a part of Kidde Global Solutions, global leader in fire and life safety solutions.  For more information, visit kidde.com or follow @KiddeFireSafety on Facebook, Instagram, and LinkedIn.

About Epic Entertainment and Media Group

Epic Entertainment and Media Group Inc specializes in delivering high-quality scripted and unscripted programming, original series, documentaries, and event television designed to captivate viewers and drive meaningful engagement. With a strong focus on innovative concepts, diverse voices, and cinematic production values, the company develops projects that resonate across broadcast, cable, and streaming platforms.  Founded by Rick Fielding and Art Edmonds, Epic Entertainment and Media Group is committed to pushing creative boundaries while maintaining the highest standards of excellence. Their collaborative approach combines artistic vision with strategic execution—ensuring every production is not only entertaining, but impactful and market-ready.  Epic Entertainment and Media Group isn't just producing television—it's crafting experiences that inform, inspire, and leave a lasting impression.

About Hearst Media Production Group

Hearst Media Production Group (HMPG), a business unit of Hearst Television, is an independent producer and distributor of original programming for TV stations, broadcast and cable networks and streaming services. HMPG produces hundreds of hours of Emmy® Award-winning programming annually across linear, streaming, digital and social media platforms for domestic and international distribution in 100 countries.  Its popular weekly educational/informational (E/I) programming blocks air weekends nationwide including "Weekend Adventure," on ABC stations; "CBS WKND," on the CBS Network; "The More You Know," on the NBC Network; "One Magnificent Morning," on the CW Network; "Mi Telemundo" on the Telemundo Network and "Go Time" on independent stations. HMPG also produces and/or distributes a diverse slate of other programming and content including the company's dedicated FAST channels Xplore, The Jack Hanna Channel, Rovr Pets, and Lucky Dog Channel, available on some of the most popular smart TVs and streaming platforms.  HMPG has offices in New York, Los Angeles, and Charlotte.  HMPG is represented by United Talent Agency.

Paraguayan Chamber of Meat (CPC) highlights falling ground beef prices, record shipments and Paraguay's role as a reliable hemispheric partner; urges Trump Administration to provide dedicated quota for Paraguay.

ASUNCIÓN, Paraguay, Oct. 22, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- The Paraguayan Chamber of Meat (CPC) today welcomed recent relief in U.S. ground beef prices and urged the Trump Administration to grant Paraguay a dedicated beef quota, citing the country's rising production, growing exports and commitment to the United States as a trusted partner in the Western Hemisphere.
releases.title: Paraguay Beef Producers: President Trump's Beef Policies Are Lowering Prices for American Families
releases.body:
Paraguayan Chamber of Meat (CPC) highlights falling ground beef prices, record shipments and Paraguay's role as a reliable hemispheric partner; urges Trump Administration to provide dedicated quota for Paraguay.

ASUNCIÓN, Paraguay, Oct. 22, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- The Paraguayan Chamber of Meat (CPC) today welcomed recent relief in U.S. ground beef prices and urged the Trump Administration to grant Paraguay a dedicated beef quota, citing the country's rising production, growing exports and commitment to the United States as a trusted partner in the Western Hemisphere.

According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, ground beef prices fell 1.3% in September – the largest monthly decline since 2024. U.S. imports of Paraguayan beef rose 46% from January through July 2026 compared with the same period in 2025, according to USDA's Foreign Agricultural Service. Shipments reached 43,000 metric tons through September. USDA also forecasts Paraguay's total 2027 beef exports at 460,000 tons carcass weight equivalent, demonstrating expanding production and strong supply capacity.

"President Donald Trump's decision to remove tariffs on Paraguayan beef is delivering real results, and demonstrates how targeted trade cooperation can support American consumers while strengthening ties with a close regional ally," said CPC President Juan Carlos Pettengill. "A dedicated quota for Paraguay would give producers and buyers the consistency they need while supporting price relief for U.S. families."

President Santiago Peña met with U.S. Deputy Secretary of State Christopher Landau in Asunción earlier this week. Beef was identified as a high priority in bilateral relations during his visit.

"The United States and Paraguay have an opportunity to show what results-driven cooperation among Western Hemisphere partners can achieve," said CPC General Manager Daniel Burt. "Paraguay has built its beef industry with partners who share our values, not with China. Expanded regional cooperation is a win for consumers, a win for producers and a win for the Americas."

About the Paraguayan Chamber of Meat

CPC is a non-profit trade association dedicated to the industrial and commercial development of the national productive sector. Comprised of members from the bovine, porcine and poultry sectors, the chamber promotes access to new and better national and international markets for Paraguayan meat. CPC represents the meat sector before the Paraguayan government and other countries to drive and implement economic public policies that strengthen the industry.

Read more: https://www.cpc.org.py/en/

releases.title: Peloton VP and Media Personality Ally Love Joins UPSHOT League and Nashville Vibe Ownership Groups
releases.body:
The Founder & CEO, wellness leader and TODAY on-air contributor brings her range of experience to the growing professional women's basketball league

JACKSONVILLE, Fla., Oct. 22, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- UPSHOT today announced that Ally Love, renowned fitness instructor, media personality and Founder/CEO, has joined the ownership groups of both the professional women's basketball league and its Nashville Vibe franchise. Love joins a growing bench of prominent investors, including WNBA legends Cheryl Miller, Ann Meyers Drysdale and Tamika Catchings, building on the more than $40 million in committed investment with which UPSHOT debuted in 2026.

A longtime figure across sports, wellness, and media, Love has built a career centered on bringing people together through movement and community. Her investment in UPSHOT and the Nashville Vibe reflects that same focus, supporting the continued growth of women's basketball and creating new opportunities for athletes and fans.

"The future of women's sports is something we have the opportunity to build, not just witness. I'm proud to join the UPSHOT League ownership group and contribute to a vision that creates opportunity, strengthens communities, and continues to elevate women's basketball and sports. I'm excited to help shape what comes next," said Love.

Love has spent more than a decade working across professional sports and entertainment, including 11 seasons as an in-arena host for the Brooklyn Nets and co-hosts NFL Play Action on Paramount+. She is also the Founder & CEO of Love Squad, a community and platform dedicated to helping people lead with confidence, clarity, and connection.

At Peloton, where she serves as Vice President of Instructor Strategy & Development in addition to being a beloved instructor, Love has created signature series including "Sundays with Love" and "HIIT & Hills." She also hosted Netflix's Dance 100, serves as a TODAY on-air contributor, and is a member of the J.P. Morgan Athletes Council, which brings together leaders across sports to help shape how the firm provides financial guidance to athletes.

"Ally has spent her career using sports and wellness to bring people together and create meaningful communities, which aligns with UPSHOT's vision for the future of women's basketball," said Andy Kaufmann, UPSHOT Co-Founder and CEO of Zawyer Sports & Entertainment. "Her ability to connect with people and turn that connection into action will be an asset as we establish the Nashville Vibe, grow the league as a whole, and create more opportunities for women in professional basketball."

Love joins UPSHOT and the Nashville Vibe as the league prepares for its second season, expanding with four new teams in 2027. Following its inaugural season in 2026, UPSHOT continues to grow its presence in new markets while attracting investors committed to the long-term growth of professional women's basketball.

About UPSHOT League

The UPSHOT League is a premier women's professional basketball league built on elite competition, player opportunity, and community connection. With a foundation rooted in high-level talent and global experience, the league aims to redefine the professional landscape while expanding opportunities for women's basketball in the United States. The league currently consists of six teams, including: Jacksonville Waves, Charlotte Crown, Greensboro Groove, Savannah Steel, Baltimore Starlings, and Nashville Vibe. For more information, including live game schedules, tickets, and real-time statistics, visit the UPSHOT league website at upshotleague.com or follow @upshotleague on major social platforms.

UPSHOT@orchestraco.com

Building on the recent introduction of FactoryTalk Conductor, support for NVIDIA Nemotron models expands deployment flexibility for manufacturers adopting industrial AI. The open-source approach enables organizations to keep engineering and production data within their own environments while leveraging Rockwell Automation-verified agents and skills to automate complex workflows with greater control over infrastructure, governance and cost.



"Manufacturers want to adopt AI in ways that align with their business, technology and governance requirements," said Matheus Bulho, SVP, software & control, Rockwell Automation. releases.title: Side Acquires Boutique Art Studio Roboto Entertainment in Creative Services Push
releases.body:
Founder Andrea Cordella appointed Global Head of Art as Side establishes new Chengdu studio

CHENGDU, China, Oct. 21, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Leading games services provider, Side, today acquired the boutique games art studio, Roboto Entertainment, strengthening its global art capabilities and presence in mainland China. Roboto Entertainment founder and industry veteran, Andrea Cordella, will lead Side's global art division and act as studio head for the new Chengdu site. His team will work closely with Side Shanghai as well as Side's wider network of art and co-development teams spread across the Americas, EMEA, and Asia.

"When half the titles at gamescom's Opening Night Live this year were made in China, the world notices. China has long been one of the most important markets for our industry, and I'm fiercely proud of the fact that our team there is hungry for more work, so we're going to grow." said Deborah Kirkham, CEO at Side.

While the games industry has reported a slowdown globally in recent years, the Chinese market is expected to grow by 4% in 2026 and hit $59.8B by 2030. It boasts some of the highest player engagement rates, esports engagement, player hours, and player spend, making the region an attractive space for developers.

"This acquisition is a double-down on a winning regional strategy. With Andrea as our Global Head of Art and a new studio in Chengdu, we now have some of the industry's best environment and world-building artistic talent," continued Kirkham.

Cordella founded Roboto Entertainment in 2014, specialising in environment and world building art for games. The Chengdu-based team has worked on AAA and AA releases across console and mobile games.

Andrea Cordella said, "I knew from the moment I met Deborah and the team at Side that the company aligned with the values my team and I hold dear. We strive for excellence and hold creativity close to our hearts – games are the only art medium where the consumer plays an equal role to the creator, and we will continue to deliver that creativity to every brief, now collaborating with teams across the world and supporting developers on a range of projects. It goes without saying, but I can't wait to get started."

Side's QA offering recently expanded through a partnership with leading AI QA platform, Modl.ai, announced at Gamescom earlier this year. Side, which provides Player Support, QA, Localisation, LQA, Datasets, Codev, Art and Audio, already offers its full suite of services to China-based developers.

The new studio, combined with new expertise in environment art through Andrea and his team, will allow the company to offer developers in China and beyond more than ever before.  

About Side: 

Side is a global video game development and services provider, offering technical and creative solutions to many of the largest developers and studios around the world. Founded in 2009, Side has grown from their Japanese roots to become a global force in the technology industry, with 15+ studios in over a dozen countries across the Americas, Europe, and Asia. Their industry-leading services include art production, game development, audio production, quality assurance, localisation, localisation QA, player support, community management, and datasets. For more information, visit www.side.inc

releases.title: NCL GT20 Caribbean Edition 2026 Kicks Off October 23 With Global Broadcast Partners, International Sponsors and 18-Match Schedule
releases.body:
From Canada to the Caribbean, CBC GEM and an expanding international broadcast network bring the tournament to fans across continents.

MISSISSAUGA, ON, Oct. 21, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- With opening night just two days away, NCL GT20 is preparing to launch Caribbean Edition 2026 at Arnos Vale Stadium on Friday, October 23. Toronto Kings and Vancouver Guardians meet in the opening match at 7 p.m. St. Vincent and the Grenadines local time (Atlantic Standard Time, UTC−4), beginning an 18-match tournament that concludes with the championship final on November 2.

The league has announced an expanded international broadcast and streaming network, a lineup of commercial sponsors and its official fixtures, bringing Canadian-rooted cricket to the Caribbean stage while showcasing experienced players and emerging talent.

WHERE TO WATCH: INTERNATIONAL BROADCAST PARTNERS

  • Canada: CBC GEM (digital streaming); ATN
  • India: Unite8 Sports and ZEE5
  • Afghanistan: Solh Sports (linear and digital)
  • Bangladesh: T Sports (linear); MyCo (digital)
  • Pakistan: Geo Sports (linear); MyCo (digital)
  • Middle East and North Africa (MENA): MyCo
  • Caribbean: Rush Live and Louder (linear and digital)
  • Latin America: Live and Louder (digital)
  • South and Sub-Saharan Africa: Africa XP / Sports Connect (linear and digital; non-exclusive)
  • Australia, New Zealand, Far East and Southeast Asia: Sports Connect (digital; non-exclusive)

Broadcast access and platform availability vary by territory. Fans should check local listings and official NCL GT20 channels for viewing information.

CANADIAN ROOTS. GLOBAL AMBITIONS.

The Caribbean Edition represents the next chapter in NCL GT20's international growth, connecting Canada's expanding cricket community with the Caribbean's longstanding sporting heritage. The league is positioning itself as a bridge between established cricket nations and emerging markets.

"Our focus is on building partnerships that take cricket beyond borders and create meaningful opportunities for the sport's future," said Gaurav Dewani, Head of Partnerships, NCL GT20. "Our Canadian roots remain central to our identity, and bringing the tournament to the Caribbean allows us to connect two important cricket communities while expanding our reach across international markets. These broadcast relationships are about more than distribution. They're about making cricket more accessible, creating greater visibility for emerging talent and building a platform that can continue to grow for years to come."

releases.title: E Ink and FUJIFILM Imaging Systems Partner to Expand Large-Format Color ePaper Signage
releases.body:
Collaboration will initially focus on signage applications for Japan's railway industry

BILLERICA, Mass., Oct. 21, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- E Ink, a pioneer and leading global developer of ePaper technology, today announced a partnership with FUJIFILM Imaging Systems Co., Ltd. to establish a large-format color ePaper signage business, initially targeting the railway sector. Upon successful completion of prototype assessments, the companies will begin introducing select sizes in 2027.

ePaper is increasingly turned to as an alternative display medium in the railway industry, especially due to labor shortages and the rising costs associated with printing, transporting, installing, and disposing of traditional paper posters.

E Ink and Fujifilm Imaging Systems will combine E Ink's ePaper technology with Fujifilm Imaging Systems' established railway-sector business foundation, implementation capabilities, and operational expertise. Together, the companies plan to provide end-to-end support for large-format color ePaper signage, spanning customer proposals, installation, and ongoing operation.

The details regarding the full-color ePaper sizes and release dates are as follows:

  • 55-inch E Ink Marquee
    • Prototype Release: December 2026
    • Mass-Production Release: March 2027
  • B1-size E Ink Marquee
    • Prototype Release: October 2027
    • Mass-Production Release: January 2028

"We see significant opportunity for E Ink's ePaper to replace traditional print posters in Japan's transportation industry, particularly as our large-format and color capabilities continue to advance," said JM Hung, President of E Ink Holdings. "With the visibility of print and the flexibility of digital updates, ePaper helps organizations streamline content changes, reduce printing and material waste, and deliver timely information using very little power."

"Fujifilm Imaging Systems' expertise in imaging, printing, color management, and quality control strongly complements E Ink's pioneering leadership in ePaper technology," said Takashi Toyofuku, Director at FUJIFILM Imaging Systems. "By bringing together these capabilities and our established customer relationships, we are well positioned to accelerate the adoption of large-format ePaper—beginning with railway advertising and signage and expanding over time into other industries throughout Japan."

About E Ink

E Ink Holdings Inc. (8069.TWO), based on technology from MIT's Media Lab, provides an ideal display medium for applications spanning eReaders and eNotes, ESLs and retail media, digital signage, IoT devices and more, enabling customers to put displays in locations previously impossible. E Ink's electrophoretic display products make it a worldwide leader for ePaper. Its low-power displays enable customers to reach their sustainability goals, and E Ink has pledged using 100% renewable energy in 2030 and reaching net zero carbon emissions by 2040. E Ink has been recognized for its efforts by receiving validation from Science-Based Targets (SBTi) and is listed in both the DJSI World and DJSI Emerging Indexes and is listed in Taiwan's Taipei Exchange (TPEx) and the Luxembourg market. For more information, please visit www.eink.com. E Ink. We Make Surfaces Smart and Green.

About FUJIFILM Imaging Systems

FUJIFILM Imaging Systems Co., Ltd. serves as the domestic sales company for Fujifilm Group imaging products in Japan. Drawing on the expertise and technologies developed by Fujifilm, the company offers photography, video and information products and services that combine quality, reliability, security and ease of use for individual and corporate customers. As a member of the Fujifilm Group, Fujifilm Imaging Systems develops products, services and solutions that respond to evolving customer needs while supporting the preservation and advancement of photography and imaging culture. Its work contributes to the Fujifilm Group's purpose: "Giving our world more smiles."

releases.title: Space Nuclear Power Corporation Awarded DARPA Agreement for Ground Test of Autonomous Nuclear Reactor Controller
releases.body:
Other Transaction Agreement to advance active reactor control through a follow-on ground test of Kilopower reactor technology

LOS ALAMOS, N.M., Oct. 21, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Space Nuclear Power Corporation (SpaceNukes) announced today that the Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency (DARPA) has awarded the company an Other Transaction Agreement (OTA) under the Fast Capacitance (Fat Cat) program. Managed by Dr. Tabitha Dodson in DARPA's Defense Sciences Office, the Fat Cat program seeks to advance autonomous reactor operation for national security missions. The contract supports development and ground testing of advanced reactor control technologies that extend the demonstrated capability of American nuclear power.

The award extends a continuous line of nuclear power development and builds directly on SpaceNukes' successful nuclear power demonstration heritage. In 2018, key members of the SpaceNukes team, while employed by Los Alamos National Laboratory and NASA, performed the foundational Kilopower Reactor Using Stirling Technology (KRUSTY) work — conducting the only full-power ground test of a new American space reactor in five decades. Under the current agreement, SpaceNukes and Los Alamos National Laboratory will design, build, and conduct a follow-on nuclear ground test of a Kilopower reactor incorporating active control rod operation—an advancement beyond the passively controlled architecture demonstrated in the 2018 KRUSTY test.

"This award recognizes the maturity and continuity of the team that designed, built, and tested KRUSTY in 2018," said Patrick McClure, COO of SpaceNukes. "We are proud to work alongside Dr. Dodson and Los Alamos National Laboratory to deliver the next demonstrated step in American nuclear power."

The phased program structure includes design, procurement, and integration gates leading to the ground demonstration, producing both nuclear-tested hardware and the engineering basis for autonomous, actively-controlled reactor operation. Integration work will be conducted at SpaceNukes' workshop in Medina, Ohio, led by Chief Engineer Marc Gibson. The work positions American industry to provide reliable nuclear power across a broader range of mission profiles, including those requiring dynamic power management and rapid response under varying operational conditions.

"There is no substitute for demonstrated technology when American national security objectives are at stake," said Andy Phelps, CEO of SpaceNukes. "This award lets us advance the work begun in the KRUSTY program and bring another tested capability forward for the nation."

About Space Nuclear Power Corporation (SpaceNukes)

Space Nuclear Power Corporation was founded on the belief that nuclear power is essential to our future, both on Earth and in space. The company's goal is to enable the successful deployment of fission reactors in space. SpaceNukes brings together the core engineering and program management team behind the foundational KRUSTY demonstration in 2018. David Poston (CTO) and Patrick McClure (COO) performed this work at Los Alamos National Laboratory; Marc Gibson (Chief Engineer) led the program at NASA Glenn Research Center. The team is joined by Omar Mireles (formerly NASA Marshall Space Flight Center) and Andy Phelps (CEO). SpaceNukes holds a license from Los Alamos National Laboratory for the Kilopower technology and operates from headquarters in Los Alamos, New Mexico, and workshops in Los Alamos with additive 3D printing and in Medina, Ohio, with thermal and vacuum capabilities.

releases.title: The most powerful superconducting magnet ever flown to space, made with Faraday Factory HTS tape, launches aboard Starburst-1
releases.body:
Zenno Astronautics' breakthrough magnetic technology incorporates special high temperature superconducting tape developed by Faraday Factory Japan

TOKYO, Oct. 21, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Faraday Factory Japan celebrates the successful launch of Zenno Astronautics' largest Supertorquer to date aboard Portal Space Systems' Starburst-1. The Almighty Magnet is the world's most powerful magnetic actuator ever built and flown to space. The launch took place aboard SpaceX's Falcon 9 Bandwagon-5 mission on October 20, 2026.

Developed and engineered by Zenno, Supertorquer uses advanced superconducting magnet technology to generate powerful magnetic interactions with Earth's magnetic field. Faraday Factory has supplied specially customized high temperature superconducting (HTS) tape to meet Zenno's demanding performance requirements for this pioneering space application.

The development of superconducting space technologies represents a major opportunity to transform how spacecraft operate and interact in orbit. High temperature superconductor magnets enable exceptionally strong magnetic fields while minimizing energy consumption, paving the way for compact, powerful, and energy-efficient space systems. Since partnering in 2024, Faraday Factory and Zenno have steadily accelerated this work.

"Almighty Magnet is opening the door to a whole new set of capabilities in space, from mass drivers and magnetic radiation shields to advanced satellite mobility. We're building and flying the superconducting technology that makes this possible, and Faraday Factory Japan is our partner in that effort," said Max Arshavsky, Founder and CEO of Zenno.

"The launch of Starburst-1 marks an important milestone for Faraday Factory, demonstrating the HTS potential to enable some of the most demanding and innovative applications of superconductivity. We strongly support game-changing Zenno's effort to electrify space technologies," said Sergey Lee, Founder and CEO of Faraday Factory Japan.

About Faraday Factory

Faraday Factory Japan runs the largest manufacturing facility of high temperature superconductor (HTS) tape worldwide. Over recent years, the company has delivered more than 10,000 km of HTS tape to hundreds of customers. The company serves a rapidly growing market of HTS tape, which is led by ever increasing demand from fusion energy, power grid, aerospace, railway, healthcare, and other high-tech markets.

www.faradaygroup.com

About Zenno

Zenno develops the most powerful magnetic technologies for space. This is a new class of superconducting systems designed to power the next era of human expansion. Our belief is simple — stable and scalable infrastructure in space will rely on resources already present there.

Zenno is building that future by harnessing one of the fundamental forces of the universe, electromagnetism. Our superconducting technologies enable fuel-free spacecraft positioning, radiation shielding, and electromagnetic acceleration systems for defense, transportation, and industrial activity in space.

https://www.zennoastronautics.com/

ESA conviction reinforces serious consequences for licence holders who circumvent electrical safety requirements and put Ontarians at risk.

MISSISSAUGA, ON, Oct. 21, 2026 /CNW/ -- The Electrical Safety Authority (ESA) is reinforcing its commitment to holding licence holders accountable following the conviction of Aya Electric Inc. and its owner and Designated Master Electrician, Razi Khan, for their involvement in a permits-for-sale scheme that enabled unlicensed electrical work at homes across Southern Ontario.
releases.title: Licensed Electrical Contractor and Owner Fined $122,000 in Permits-for-Sale Scheme
releases.body:
ESA conviction reinforces serious consequences for licence holders who circumvent electrical safety requirements and put Ontarians at risk.

MISSISSAUGA, ON, Oct. 21, 2026 /CNW/ -- The Electrical Safety Authority (ESA) is reinforcing its commitment to holding licence holders accountable following the conviction of Aya Electric Inc. and its owner and Designated Master Electrician, Razi Khan, for their involvement in a permits-for-sale scheme that enabled unlicensed electrical work at homes across Southern Ontario.

Aya Electric and Khan were fined a combined $122,000 under the Electricity Act, 1998 after an ESA investigation uncovered a paid arrangement in which the company obtained electrical permits for work performed by an unlicensed contractor.

ESA's investigation found that Aya Electric obtained permits for electrical work at six residential properties located in Clarington, Brantford, Milton and Markham. Khan collected payments for the permits while an unlicensed contractor carried out the work. The individual was not employed by Aya Electric, had no electrical qualifications, was not properly insured and worked without supervision from the company or Khan.

In September 2026, Aya Electric and Khan pleaded guilty to offences under the Electricity Act, 1998. The company was fined $92,000 and Khan was fined $30,000 and placed on probation. ESA is currently reviewing the matter and considering whether further administrative action is warranted.

In its sentencing reasons, the Ontario Court of Justice characterized Khan's conduct as deceptive and bordering on fraud, noting that he charged more than twice the cost of an ESA permit. The court considered Khan's licensing status an aggravating factor, recognizing that he understood ESA's permitting process and used that knowledge for financial gain. The court also emphasized the potentially catastrophic consequences of the offences, including fire and loss of life, and the importance of imposing penalties that deter others from circumventing electrical safety requirements.

"Using a licensed business to obtain permits for an unlicensed contractor undermines the protections Ontario's electrical safety requirements provide," said Emily Larose, Vice President of Regulatory and General Counsel, Electrical Safety Authority. "We help licence holders meet their responsibilities, but when those responsibilities are deliberately ignored, we will act. These fines send a strong message that profiting from arrangements that put public safety at risk carries serious consequences."

ESA investigators also observed Khan performing electrical work at a seventh home in Brantford alongside two unlicensed contractors. No electrical permit had been obtained from ESA for that job. As Aya Electric's Designated Master Electrician, Khan was responsible for planning and supervising electrical work carried out on the company's behalf.

"A Licensed Electrical Contractor's licence cannot be rented, loaned or used to legitimize unlicensed electrical work," said Sarah Kempel, Director of Licensing, Electrical Safety Authority. "Obtaining permits for work that is being performed by an unlicensed contractor represents a deliberate disregard for Ontario's licensing framework and the accountability that comes with holding a licence."

Help protect your community: report electrical safety concerns

By law, only Licensed Electrical Contractors (LECs) can be hired to perform electrical work in Ontario homes and businesses. If you suspect unlicensed electrical work or a Licensed Electrical Contractor failing to meet their responsibilities, report your concerns to ESA. Reports can be submitted anonymously, but the more details you provide, the better equipped ESA is to investigate and take action.

Report suspicious electrical activity: Visit ESAsafe.com/ReportAContractor.

Verify a Licensed Electrical Contractor: Before hiring someone to do electrical work in your home, ask for their seven-digit ECRA/ESA electrical contractor licence number and check it at FindaContractor.ESAsafe.com.

If hiring a general contractor, confirm they use an LEC for electrical work. An electrician's qualifications or a Master Electrician's licence alone are not sufficient.

About the Electrical Safety Authority

The Electrical Safety Authority's (ESA's) role is to improve public electrical safety in Ontario. ESA is an administrative authority responsible for administering specific regulations under the Electricity Act, 1998 (Part VIII) related to the Ontario Electrical Safety Code, the licensing of Electrical Contractors and Master Electricians, electricity distribution system safety, and electrical product safety. ESA works extensively with stakeholders throughout the province on education, training and promotion to foster electrical safety across the province.

More information on the Electrical Safety Authority can be found at ESAsafe.com, through Facebook, X and on LinkedIn.

releases.title: Rockwell Automation Introduces FactoryTalk Conductor, an AI-Native Orchestration Platform for Industrial Automation
releases.body:
New software connects AI agents, skills and workflows across the automation lifecycle

MILWAUKEE, Oct. 21, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Rockwell Automation, Inc. (NYSE: ROK), the world's largest company dedicated to industrial automation and digital transformation, today announced the introduction of FactoryTalk® Conductor™, a new AI-native orchestration platform designed to coordinate AI-powered work across the industrial automation lifecycle, creating a foundation for AI-enabled workflows from system design through operation and maintenance. The software will make its public debut at Automation Fair® 2026 in Boston, where attendees will receive an exclusive first look ahead of its planned commercial availability in the first quarter of 2027.

According to Rockwell Automation's 2026 State of Smart Manufacturing Report, one-third of manufacturing operations are already AI-augmented, with adoption expected to accelerate in the years ahead. As manufacturers move from AI experimentation to broader deployment, they need practical ways to connect technology, workflows and expertise. FactoryTalk Conductor is designed to meet that need through a single platform that brings AI together across engineering environments.

"The next phase of industrial AI will be defined by orchestration rather than individual copilots," said Craig Resnick, Vice President, ARC Advisory Group. "Manufacturers need AI technologies that can coordinate tasks across software systems, engineering tools and operational data. FactoryTalk Conductor reflects the industry's evolution toward agentic automation by bringing AI agents, workflows and industrial expertise together in a unified environment."

FactoryTalk Conductor enables users to initiate engineering tasks using natural language and intelligently connects the software, AI capabilities and workflows needed to complete them. At launch, the platform will integrate with Studio 5000 Logix Designer®, Logix Echo™, Emulate3D® and FactoryTalk® Optix™, providing coverage across key design, development, simulation and testing workflows. Additional integrations across Rockwell Automation's software portfolio, including FactoryTalk® Design Studio™, FactoryTalk® Historian, Plex® and Fiix®, are planned to follow, expanding AI-powered workflows across the industrial automation lifecycle.

"What makes FactoryTalk Conductor unique is the combination of AI orchestration and trusted industrial expertise," said Matheus Bulho, senior vice president, software & control, Rockwell Automation. "Customers can leverage Rockwell Automation-verified agents and skills, create capabilities tailored to their business, and connect AI across software, data and services. This creates a scalable foundation for accelerating engineering work while maintaining the standards required in industrial environments."

Key benefits include:

  • Supporting enterprise AI and governance requirements, giving organizations the flexibility to leverage FactoryTalk Hub-hosted AI services or connect their preferred large or small language models, including locally hosted open-weight models that can help reduce ongoing token consumption costs.
  • Accelerating engineering workflows across the automation lifecycle by coordinating activities across design, development, testing and verification environments.
  • Reducing complexity across software applications by enabling AI-powered workflows that span Studio 5000 Logix Designer, Logix Echo, Emulate3D, FactoryTalk Optix and other Rockwell Automation solutions.
  • Applying AI with greater confidence and reliability through Rockwell Automation-developed integrations that connect software, data and services across industrial operations.
  • Extending trusted automation expertise through Rockwell Automation-verified agents and skills, helping teams accelerate work with capabilities purpose-built for industrial applications.

Manufacturers attending Automation Fair 2026 will be able to experience FactoryTalk Conductor demonstrations across multiple show floor experiences, including Technology & Services Showcase, Industry Pavillion, Innovations, as well as dedicated technical sessions.

Additional information about FactoryTalk Conductor and Automation Fair can be found at www.rockwellautomation.com.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is FactoryTalk Conductor?

FactoryTalk Conductor is an AI-native orchestration platform that connects AI agents, skills, workflows and automation software to help engineers accelerate system design, development and testing activities through natural language interactions and trusted industrial expertise.

How is FactoryTalk Conductor different from an AI copilot?

While traditional AI copilots assist with individual tasks, FactoryTalk Conductor enables multiple AI agents, workflows and software tools to work together across engineering processes. This enables broader automation of complex, multi-step activities that span applications, data sources and teams.

When will FactoryTalk Conductor be available?

FactoryTalk Conductor will be previewed at Automation Fair 2026 in Boston and is expected to be commercially available in the first quarter of 2027.

What Rockwell Automation products can FactoryTalk Conductor work with?

FactoryTalk Conductor is designed to work across a growing portfolio of Rockwell Automation software. At launch, it will support Studio 5000 Logix Designer®, Logix Echo™, Emulate3D® and FactoryTalk® Optix™, with additional integrations planned for FactoryTalk® Design Studio™, FactoryTalk® Historian, Plex®, Fiix® and other solutions over time.

Can customers create and deploy their own AI agents and skills?

Yes. In addition to Rockwell Automation-verified agents and skills, customers can create and deploy their own agents and skills to support company standards, industry requirements and unique engineering workflows

About Rockwell Automation

Rockwell Automation, Inc. (NYSE: ROK), is a global leader in industrial automation and digital transformation. We connect the imaginations of people with the potential of technology to expand what is humanly possible, making the world more productive and more sustainable. Headquartered in Milwaukee, Wisconsin, Rockwell Automation employs approximately 26,000 problem solvers dedicated to our customers in more than 100 countries. To learn more about how we are bringing the Connected Enterprise® to life across industrial enterprises, visit www.rockwellautomation.com.

releases.body:
Now accepting orders, the AURA 3 Series combines up to 8,000:1 native contrast, up to 5,700 ISO lumens of brightness, and 4K 120Hz high-refresh-rate support for exceptional picture quality and smooth, responsive viewing.

NEW YORK, Oct. 20, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- XGIMI, a global leader in premium smart projection and home entertainment, today announces the official launch of its AURA 3 Series, a new generation of ultra-short-throw (UST) laser TVs first showcased at IFA 2026. Built around XGIMI's vision of Living Room Cinema, the series combines advanced projection technology, cinematic picture quality, and high-performance gaming for modern living spaces.

Building on the iris technology first introduced in the TITAN Noir Series, the AURA 3 Series features XGIMI's Dual Dynamic Iris system, delivering native contrast of up to 8,000:1 for deeper blacks and more nuanced shadow detail. With up to 5,700 ISO lumens of brightness, an RGB triple-laser light source, premium cinematic format support, and 4K 120Hz high-refresh-rate support, the series brings together vivid picture quality and smooth performance for movies, live sports, and gaming.

With a 0.163:1 ultra-short-throw ratio, the AURA 3 Series projects a 120-inch image from approximately 8 inches away, with screen sizes reaching up to 200 inches. This space-saving design delivers a cinema-scale viewing experience without requiring a ceiling-mounted projector or a dedicated home theater room.

Engineered for Cinematic Picture Quality and Gaming

The AURA 3 Series combines advanced light control and RGB triple-laser technology to deliver premium large-screen entertainment. Key features of the flagship AURA 3 Max include:

  • Up to 5,700 ISO Lumens for bright, vivid images
  • Up to 8,000:1 Native Contrast with Dual Dynamic Iris
  • X-VISION AI Image Processor
  • Built-in Google TV
  • Dolby Vision®, HDR10+, HLG, IMAX Enhanced & Filmmaker Mode
  • Anti-RBE technology for reduced rainbow effect in both 2D and 3D
  • Cinematic 3D with two pairs of 3D glasses included
  • 80W Harman Kardon speakers with Dolby Atmos
  • 4K at 120Hz, with VRR, ALLM, and AMD FreeSync Premium for smoother, more responsive gameplay. The high refresh rate also helps reduce the perceived rainbow effect (RBE), contributing to a more comfortable viewing experience.

From cinematic movies and live sports to fast-paced gaming, the AURA 3 Series brings versatile, big-screen entertainment into everyday living spaces.

Exclusive Kickstarter Pricing and Bundle Options

The AURA 3 Series launches on Kickstarter with two models at exclusive introductory prices:

  • AURA 3 Max: $2,399 (MSRP $4,999)
  • AURA 3 Pro: $2,199 (MSRP $3,999)

Exclusive AURA 3 Max Bundle Options

For those looking to create a complete large-screen setup, XGIMI offers exclusive Kickstarter pricing on several AURA 3 Max bundles, pairing the projector with premium screen options:

  • AURA 3 Max + 120" XGIMI Ascend UST: $4,999 (MSRP $8,998)
  • AURA 3 Max + 100" XGIMI Ascend UST: $4,299 (MSRP $7,998)
  • AURA 3 Max + 120" Fresnel ALR Screen: $3,699 (MSRP $6,998)
  • AURA 3 Max + 120" Black Grid ALR Screen: $3,999 (MSRP $7,498)
  • AURA 3 Max + 140"/150" Fresnel ALR Screen: $5,799 (MSRP $9,998)

Additional screen sizes and a motorized cabinet for UST projectors will also be available as add-ons, giving backers the flexibility to customize their setup with their preferred screen and accessories during checkout.

Shipping is expected to begin in December 2026 for the AURA 3 Series projectors, followed by fixed ALR screens in January 2027 and XGIMI Ascend floor-rising screens in February 2027.

For more information, visit the official XGIMI AURA 3 Series Kickstarter page.

About XGIMI

Since 2013, the state-of-the-art XGIMI projectors have helped countless people worldwide to create genuinely immersive audio-visual experiences. Working with reputable partners like Google, Harman Kardon, and Texas Instruments, XGIMI builds all-in-one entertainment devices, perfected due to their user-oriented philosophy. Through industry-leading innovation, streamlined setups, and unique designs, XGIMI always strives to develop the best home and portable projectors for everyone to enjoy. XGIMI is also expanding their expertise into commercial projector technology to bring immersive experiences to more spaces. Learn more at XGIMI Projector Technology.

releases.title: LMBPN® Publishing Expands Library Access Through New Partnership with Hoopla Digital
releases.body:
More than 3,000 titles, including multilingual editions, to reach participating U.S. public libraries

LAS VEGAS, Oct. 20, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- LMBPN® Publishing today announced a distribution agreement with Hoopla Digital, expanding access to its catalog of more than 3,000 titles through participating U.S. public libraries.

For the first time, LMBPN's full catalog, including multilingual titles, is set to become broadly available through Hoopla, helping library patrons discover its authors and series while expanding libraries' selection of genre fiction.

LMBPN's catalog has generated nearly 17.5 million combined book sales and Kindle Unlimited reading equivalents worldwide, with more than 5.9 billion Kindle Edition Normalized Pages (KENP) read. Its science fiction, fantasy, urban fantasy, paranormal, romantasy, LitRPG, and action-adventure titles include long-running series with established global readerships.

"This is an important expansion for LMBPN because it gives more readers a way to discover our authors, explore our worlds, and enjoy our long-running series," said Robin Cutler, President of LMBPN® Publishing. "Libraries remain one of the most trusted avenues for book discovery. Through our partnership with Hoopla, we are opening our catalog to a new audience of library readers and making our stories accessible on a scale that was not previously possible."

"Libraries have always been a place for discovery, and requests for new genres and diverse, multilingual content continue to grow," said Brad Rose, VP of Content Strategy at Hoopla. "Our partnership with LMBPN helps us meet that demand, giving libraries an even wider range of titles to offer their patrons."

The agreement gives library patrons a new way to discover LMBPN's books and participating libraries access to high-interest independent fiction, including multilingual editions. For LMBPN, Hoopla extends its reach beyond retail and subscription channels.

About LMBPN® Publishing

Founded in 2015 by bestselling author Michael Anderle, LMBPN® Publishing is an independent publisher of more than 3,000 titles across science fiction, fantasy, urban fantasy, paranormal, romantasy, LitRPG, action-adventure, and related genres. Its fast-paced, long-running series reach international readers through digital publishing and multilingual editions.

Michael Anderle is an Amazon Top 30 bestselling author and Dragon Award nominee. In 2024, Amazon recognized him as the fifth most-read Kindle Unlimited author in the UK over the program's first decade.

About Hoopla Digital

With a mission to serve public libraries and their patrons, Hoopla is the only all-in-one app that provides online and mobile access to millions of eBooks, audiobooks, comics and manga, music, movies, TV, and more with BingePass. Available in 115+ world languages, content on Hoopla is available for free with a valid library card. Hoopla is the pioneer of the pay per use model that allows library patrons to borrow content immediately, no waits or holds required. Headquartered in Holland, Ohio, Hoopla is a service of Midwest Tape, a trusted partner to public libraries for over 35 years. For more information, or to download the Hoopla app, visit hoopladigital.com.

releases.title: Defense Unicorns Launches End-to-End CMMC Solution to Help Defense Contractors Accelerate Certification and Preserve Contract Eligibility
releases.body:
Defense Unicorns CMMC addresses NIST SP 800-171 requirements, providing hands-on guidance, assessor-ready evidence, and year-round continuous compliance for the Defense Industrial Base

SAN ANTONIO, Oct. 20, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Defense Unicorns, a leader in open-source and secure defense software delivery, today announced the launch of its end-to-end Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification (CMMC) solution, Defense Unicorns CMMC. Defense Unicorns CMMC is designed specifically for companies across the Defense Industrial Base (DIB), including small businesses, independent software vendors (ISVs), and enterprise defense contractors. The new offering fast-tracks NIST SP 800-171 readiness while ensuring continuous, year-round compliance.

"A stronger defense industrial base gives our nation greater capacity to deliver what the mission demands," said Dr. Rob Slaughter, CEO and Co-Founder of Defense Unicorns. "We need more companies bringing their talent, technology, and innovation to defense. Our job is to help them enter that market, grow, and deliver securely. By reducing the burden of CMMC readiness, we help contractors focus their people and resources on building the capabilities our warfighters need."

With Department of War contract eligibility tied directly to cybersecurity readiness, defense contractors face mounting pressure to navigate complex technical controls, gap remediation, and extensive documentation requirements. Defense Unicorns CMMC eliminates compliance bottlenecks by combining expert implementation, tailored assessment documentation, and ongoing maintenance without forcing contractors to overhaul existing IT infrastructure.

Key Offerings & Capabilities

Defense Unicorns CMMC provides a comprehensive path to accreditation built around four core pillars:

  • End-to-End Implementation & Maintenance: Hands-on configuration of security controls, gap remediation, assessment support, and ongoing guidance to keep documentation and evidence current as systems, scope, and flow-down requirements change.
  • Vendor-Agnostic System Compatibility: Seamless integration within existing IT environments, including Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, and complex hybrid operating systems—working alongside existing Managed Service Providers (MSPs and internal IT).
  • Assessor-Ready Evidence Packets: Generation of complete, audit-ready compliance packages containing tailored System Security Plans (SSPs), policies, procedures, architecture diagrams, databases, and supporting evidence.
  • Partnering with Certified Assessment Bodies (C3PAOs): Close collaboration with Certified Third-Party Assessment Organizations (C3PAOs) to remediate failed CMMC assessments and ensure streamlined evaluation workflows.

Despite recent regulatory pauses surrounding Phase II assessment rollouts, contractual requirements under DFARS 252.204-7012 and Phase I NIST SP 800-171 self-assessments remain fully active. Defense Unicorns' expert team equips DIB organizations with the technical safeguards and continuous evidence generation required to satisfy government audits and protect Federal Contract Information (FCI) and Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI) at all times.

To learn more about Defense Unicorns CMMC or to schedule a consultation with a Defense Unicorns CMMC Certified Professional, visit defenseunicorns.com/solutions/industry/cmmc/.

About Defense Unicorns

Defense Unicorns is a veteran-owned defense technology company founded in 2021 by Rob Slaughter, Jeff McCoy, and Andrew Greene to make software a strategic deterrent for the U.S. Department of War. The company builds open-source, airgap-native technologies that enable the secure development, delivery, and sustainment of mission software across cloud, on-premises, airgapped, and tactical edge environments. Defense Unicorns' technology is trusted by operators of critical systems across the U.S. Navy, Army, Air Force, and Space Force. Learn more at https://defenseunicorns.com.

releases.title: SUBARU, THE ASPCA®, AND IHEARTMEDIA EXPAND PARTNERSHIP TO SUPPORT SHELTER ANIMALS THROUGH ADDITIONAL $25,000 DONATION AND NATIONAL MEDIA CAMPAIGN
releases.body:
New Collaboration builds upon Subaru's 19-year partnership with the ASPCA® and shines a spotlight on National Make A Dog's Day and October's Subaru Loves Pets® campaign

CAMDEN, N.J., Oct. 19, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Subaru of America, through its Subaru Loves Pets® initiative, together with iHeartImpact, a community impact division of iHeartMedia designed to help corporate brands partner with nonprofits through their advertising spends with iHeartMedia, today announced an expanded collaboration with the ASPCA® (The American Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals®) to help improve the lives of shelter animals across the country. As part of the partnership, Subaru donated an additional $25,000 to support their ongoing commitment to helping shelter animals find loving homes.

This collaboration builds upon Subaru's 19-year partnership with the ASPCA, which began in 2008 through the Subaru Share the Love® Event. Through the Subaru Loves Pets initiative, Subaru and its retailers are committed to improving the lives of as many shelter animals as possible and are proud to be the largest corporate donor to the ASPCA. With more than $75 million donated to national and local pet-focused organizations, they have supported the adoption, rescue, transport and health of more than 900,000 animals.

Alan Bethke, Senior Vice President of Marketing, Subaru of America, Inc.: "Subaru and our national network of retailers are fortunate enough to partner with the ASPCA and to see the profound impact that a pet's unconditional love can have on peoples' lives. With this additional donation and recognition from iHeartMedia, the work we are doing together as part of Subaru Loves Pets will go even further to support the most vulnerable animals in need, and to help shelter animals find loving homes."

Every October, Subaru retailers partner with local animal welfare organizations to help prepare shelter pets for adoption through ASPCA-administered grants and a series of pet-focused events held in communities across the country. As part of this year's campaign, Subaru will celebrate its eighth annual National Make A Dog's Day on October 22 – a day created by Subaru to encourage dog lovers nationwide to do something special for their dogs while inspiring more people to consider adopting, fostering or supporting an Underdog as a life-changing way to Make A Dog's Day. Subaru is especially passionate about supporting older and disabled dogs – affectionally called the "Underdogs" – who are often overlooked and spend more time waiting in shelters to find loving homes.

Meredith Galli, Director of Corporate Partnerships, ASPCA: "The ASPCA is proud to be the recipient of this generous donation from iHeartImpact, made possible through our longstanding partnership with Subaru of America. We are thankful to Subaru for selecting the ASPCA as the beneficiary of this gift, which will help strengthen our efforts to create better outcomes for vulnerable animals nationwide."

The need remains significant. According to the ASPCA, 5.8 million dogs and cats entered shelters and rescues in 2025, with many waiting day after day for the chance to find a loving home.

Together, Subaru, the ASPCA and iHeartImpact aim to inspire more people to support shelter animals while expanding awareness of Subaru's long-standing commitment to pet adoption and welfare. Through the partnership, iHeartMedia and iHeartImpact will help expand the reach of Subaru's October campaign with a national broadcast initiative designed to encourage audiences across the country to learn more about shelter pet adoption and fostering.

Jenna Craig, President, National Media Team, iHeartMedia: "National Make A Dog's Day is a powerful reminder of the impact each of us can have on the lives of shelter animals. As a media partner that reaches 9 out of 10 Americans every month, we're proud to collaborate with Subaru and the ASPCA to help bring this message to our audiences nationwide and inspire more people to adopt, foster, and support pets waiting for a second chance."

Learn more about how Subaru is supporting shelter animals across the country at Subaru.com/pets.

About Subaru of America, Inc.

Subaru of America, Inc. (SOA) is an indirect wholly owned subsidiary of Subaru Corporation of Japan. Headquartered in Camden, N.J., the company markets and distributes Subaru vehicles, parts, and accessories through a network of about 640 retailers across the United States. All Subaru products are manufactured in zero-landfill plants, including Subaru of Indiana Automotive, Inc., the only U.S. automobile manufacturing plant designated a backyard wildlife habitat by the National Wildlife Federation. SOA is guided by the Subaru Love Promise®, which is the company's vision to show love and respect to everyone and to support its communities and customers nationwide. Over the past 20 years, SOA and the SOA Foundation have donated more than $357 million to causes that Subaru and its customers care about, and Subaru employees have logged more than 130,000 volunteer hours. Through these actions and more, Subaru is dedicated to being More Than a Car Company® and to making the world a better place.

For additional information, visit media.subaru.com.

Follow us on Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, TikTok, and YouTube.

About the ASPCA

The ASPCA® (The American Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals®) believes every animal deserves to live free from suffering. For 160 years, we've been on the frontlines to save, transform and protect millions of lives in the fight against animal cruelty. As the nation's first and leading animal welfare organization, we assist animals in need through on-the-ground disaster and cruelty interventions, behavioral rehabilitation, animal relocation and placement, legal and legislative advocacy, and the advancement of the sheltering and veterinary communities through research, training and resources. As a 501(c)(3) not-for-profit corporation with more than 2 million supporters nationwide, our commitment to eliminating animal cruelty is unwavering. For more information, visit aspca.org, and follow the ASPCA on Facebook, X, Instagram, LinkedIn and TikTok.

About iHeartMedia, Inc.

[Nasdaq: IHRT] is the leading audio media company in America, with nine out of ten Americans listening to iHeart broadcast radio in every month. iHeart's broadcast radio assets alone have a larger audience in the U.S. than any other media outlet and over four times the ad-enabled audience of the largest digital only audio service. iHeart is the largest podcast publisher according to both Podtrac and Triton, with more downloads than the next two podcast publishers combined, has the most recognizable live events across all genres of music, has the number one social footprint among audio players, has the highest-reach and most engaged influencers, and is the only fully integrated audio ad tech solution across broadcast, streaming and podcasts. The company continues to leverage its strong audience connection and unparalleled consumer reach to build new platforms, products and services. Visit iHeartMedia.com for more company information.
