releases.title: Under The Motto "Distribution Is The New Moat," Nomada Fund Launches As The World's First New Media Fund
releases.body:
Backed by leading media outlets and communities in the U.S. and Latin America, the fund invests distribution instead of capital as AI makes software cheaper to build and community and trust become key advantages.

MIAMI, Oct. 19, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Nomada Fund today launched as the world's first New Media fund. Instead of capital, it invests Media Credits in sustained distribution across more than 10 New Media platforms, including newsletters, podcasts, communities, events, SEO, and GEO.

The firm is backed by ILB Media Group, a New Media conglomerate of more than 20 finance and investment outlets in the U.S. and Latin America, giving portfolio startups early distribution to investors, founders, and customers.

A proven model

Nomada Fund uses the same financial structure as Media for Equity (M4E) funds, where media groups trade advertising space for equity, with two differences: it operates on New Media platforms instead of TV, radio, or print, and it invests at Pre-seed and Seed rather than at maturity. This makes it the world's first Distribution for Equity (D4E) fund.

With AI agents and no-code tools, a small team can recreate a working product in days. What competitors cannot copy is the trust of people who follow a company, open its emails, and recommend it. Hence the firm's motto: "Distribution is the new moat." A startup's moat, what protects it from competitors, used to be technology. Today, it is the ability to reach the right people and turn visibility into trust.

"A startup's most valuable asset is no longer just its product, but its brand and relationships," said Jose Kont.

The team

Co-founder and Managing Partner Jose Kont is a New Media expert with 20+ years of experience and partner at Impacta VC, CAFI, and Cuantico VP. Co-founder and Venture Partner Israel García Ballesteros is CEO and founder of Startuplinks, the leading Spanish-speaking community of VC funds and accelerators, with 270+ institutional members. They are joined by Venture Partners Rodrigo Giacaman (Startups Latam), Ileana Figueroa (Pulso Capital), and Jose Manuel Aguirre (TECHLA), and by legal partner Eugenia di Marco, trained at UC Berkeley School of Law and MIT.

Rival IQ's 2026 Social Media Industry Benchmark Report puts brands' median Instagram engagement at 0.30% of followers, down from 0.36%. Nomada Fund helps startups move that "rented attention" into owned channels like newsletters, communities, and events.

"When anyone can build software over a weekend, the edge goes to whoever reaches the right people first," the firm said.

releases.title: Xtalks Named Media Partner for the 2026 CTO Clinical Trials Conference
releases.body:
The upcoming Toronto conference will bring together clinical research leaders to discuss Canada's competitiveness, innovations in clinical trial design and opportunities to improve patient access to research.

TORONTO, Oct. 16, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Xtalks is pleased to announce its role as an official Media Partner for the 2026 CTO Clinical Trials Conference, taking place November 4–5, 2026, at the Hilton Toronto. Hosted by Clinical Trials Ontario (CTO), the two-day event will bring together leaders from the pharmaceutical and medical device industries, healthcare, academia, research institutions and patient organizations to exchange ideas on the future of clinical trials in Canada.

The 2026 conference will explore how Canada can strengthen its position in global clinical research, with discussions on improving trial efficiency, integrating research into patient care and expanding access to clinical trials.

"CTO's Clinical Trials Conference has become one of Canada's most important forums for bringing together diverse voices from across the clinical trials community to share knowledge, challenge thinking and drive innovation," said Susan Marlin, President & CEO, CTO. "We look forward to welcoming delegates and presenters from across Canada and around the world to help shape better, smarter and faster clinical trials that ultimately deliver greater value for patients and participants."

The program will feature keynote presentations from Christine Elliott, former Ontario Minister of Health and Deputy Premier, and Dr. Tor Biering-Sørensen, Professor and Founding Head of the Center for Translational Cardiology and Pragmatic Randomized Trials. Elliott will examine why Canada needs to become more competitive in clinical research and better connect research with patient care, while Dr. Biering-Sørensen will discuss clinical trial innovations from Denmark and the European Union (EU).

Other sessions will address the modernization of clinical trial regulations, the use of AI and health data in research, and efforts to accelerate study start-up. This includes a discussion of early lessons from CTO's QuickSTART initiative, which has demonstrated a 45-day study start-up timeline in its first studies.

Attendees will also gain insights into psilocybin research, including clinical trials underway in Canada and the opportunities and challenges surrounding psychedelic-assisted care.

The agenda will also explore equitable access to clinical trials, Indigenous research sovereignty and approaches to making research more patient-centred. Sessions will examine advance consent in acute stroke trials and how a breast cancer study challenged conventional treatment approaches.

"Having attended last year's CTO Clinical Trials Conference, I was struck by the energy in the room and the thoughtful questions and exchanges among attendees," said Soumya Shashikumar, Senior Life Sciences Journalist at Xtalks. "As a Media Partner, Xtalks looks forward to support this year's discussions on clinical trial innovation, efficiency and patient access."

  • Dates: November 4–5, 2026
  • Location: Hilton Toronto, Toronto, Ontario

For more information and to register for the event, visit the 2026 CTO Clinical Trials Conference website.

SALT LAKE CITY, Oct. 15, 2026 /PRNewswire/ --

MEDIA BRIEFING & PRESS ADVISORY

SUBJECT: Media Availability and Briefing: Civil Rights Lawsuit Filed Concerning Witness Interference (Milton v. Essick and Lackey, Case No. 2:26-cv-01005)

1. EXECUTIVE SUMMARY & ADVISORY

A federal lawsuit was filed on October 13, 2026, in the United States District Court for the District of Utah (Central Division) under 42 U.S.C. § 1985(2). The action, titled Trevor R. Milton v. Christopher S. Essick and Paul Lackey (Case No. 2:26-cv-01005), alleges a coordinated extrajudicial conspiracy aimed at intimidating and deterring a key prospective defense witness during federal court proceedings. Members of the press are invited to request interview availability with key individuals associated with the filing.

2. FACTS OUTLINED IN THE COURT FILING

The following factual assertions are derived strictly from the formal Complaint filed in federal court:

  • Parties Involved:
    • Plaintiff: Trevor R. Milton, Founder and former Chief Executive Officer of Nikola Corporation (Nikola).
    • Defendants: Christopher S. Essick (alleged in the Complaint to be an FBI Special Agent assigned to the Counterintelligence Division of the New York Field Office, sued in his individual capacity) and Paul Lackey. Essick worked, and continues to work in the same District of New York that brought charges against Milton in the United States vs. Milton case.
  • Core Allegations:
    • The Complaint alleges that Defendants operated concealed pseudonymous social media accounts (including @lfxs1212, @CntrlScrut1nizr, and @InsiderNikola) while taking financial positions adverse to Nikola Corporation. FBI agent Essick admitted to trading Nikola stock and making money through his burner accounts.
    • The filing alleges that Defendants conducted a targeted online campaign directed at favorable witnesses who were planning on testifying on behalf of Milton such as Jason Roycht, former Vice President of Technology Development at Nikola and a prospective defense witness possessing direct knowledge of Nikola's technology programs and executive communications.
    • According to the filing, the campaign included demands for Mr. Roycht to "turn states evidence," public calls for his indictment, exposure of personal accounts, and assertions of advanced law enforcement knowledge.
  • Alleged Impact on Legal Defense:
    • The Complaint alleges that this harassment caused Mr. Roycht to decline meetings with Mr. Milton's defense counsel, restricting the defense's access to a percipient witness and depriving Mr. Milton of witness assistance during federal trial preparation. Actions targeting witnesses are considered obstruction of justice, witness tampering and potentially RICO related offenses.

3. CONTEXT: MILTON FEDERAL CASE AND PRESIDENTIAL PARDON

To ensure factual accuracy and context regarding Mr. Milton's legal background:

  • Following trial proceedings in United States v. Milton, No. 1:21-cr-00478 (S.D.N.Y.), Mr. Milton pursued legal remedies regarding the trial's fairness and witness access.
  • On March 27, 2025, Trevor R. Milton received a full and unconditional Presidential Pardon for the offenses of conviction in United States v. Milton from President Donald J. Trump.

4. MEDIA INTERVIEW OPPORTUNITIES

Credentialed members of the media may schedule interviews with the following individuals:

  1. Trevor R. Milton — Plaintiff; Founder and former CEO of Nikola Corporation.
  2. Jason Roycht — Former Vice President of Technology Development at Nikola Corporation; central subject of the witness interference detailed in the filing.
  3. Robert S. Frenchman — Legal Counsel for Plaintiff; Partner at Dynamis LLP.

5. ACCOMPANYING BACKGROUND MATERIALS & PRESS KIT

The PR Office is supplying media outlets with comprehensive background documents, available and linked below:

  • Document 1: Full Copy of Legal Filing — Complete text of the Complaint filed in Milton v. Essick et al., Case No. 2:26-cv-01005 (D. Utah).
  • Document 2: Backgrounder on Trevor R. Milton — Biographical details, founding history of Nikola Corporation, and documentation of the March 27, 2025 full Presidential Pardon by President Donald J. Trump. Current role as CEO of SyberJet.
  • Document 3: Backgrounder on Jason Roycht — Professional background in technology development and timeline of relevant events referenced in the filing.
  • Document 4: Backgrounder on Legal Counsel — Overview of legal representation by Dynamis LLP Robert S. Frenchman 
  • Document 5: Milton Federal Case Summary — Chronology and context of United States v. Milton and subsequent civil rights litigation.

6. MEDIA CONTACT & SCHEDULING

To schedule interviews, or confirm credentialing, please contact:

releases.title: Procore Names COMPASS Its Preferred Subcontractor Prequalification Solution
releases.body:
Prequal for All Gives Risk Teams and Project Teams One Source of Subcontractor Risk

TORONTO, Oct. 15, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Bespoke Metrics today announced that Procore Technologies, Inc. (NYSE: PCOR), a leading global provider of construction management software, has named COMPASS its preferred subcontractor prequalification solution. The expanded partnership launches Prequal for All and is available to Procore customers today.

Prequal for All makes COMPASS prequalification available to every general contractor and subcontractor working in Procore. Subcontractors complete one standardized prequalification profile, keep it current, and share it with any general contractor they choose, joining more than 150,000 subcontractors already on COMPASS.

COMPASS analyzes each subcontractor's financial, safety, insurance, and operational information and produces the COMPASS Q Score (the Construction Credit Score) with recommended prequalification outcomes. Risk teams set standards and review exceptions in COMPASS, while project teams see the results in Procore, where work is bid and awarded.

"Prequalification is a critical risk management function that demands purpose-built tools and a data-rich platform," said Geoff Lewis, Senior Vice President of Product at Procore. "By deepening our partnership with Bespoke Metrics, and further integrating their insights directly into Procore's AI-powered platform, we are able to replace passive, static forms with active, modern risk intelligence. Together, we are enhancing the value we deliver to mutual customers by enabling them to make smarter and faster risk management decisions."

COMPASS is one of the first partners connected to Procore through the Model Context Protocol (MCP), the emerging standard for how AI systems share information. Bespoke Metrics and Procore are building on that connection with agentic AI prequalification, starting with a COMPASS Risk Agent expected later this year. From bid to award, this new agent will enable project teams to see where every subcontractor stands without leaving Procore.

The principle is simple: risk intelligence should travel, sensitive data should not. Subcontractors control which general contractors can see their COMPASS profile, and their financial statements stay in COMPASS. What reaches Procore is the result: the Q Score and prequalification outcomes.

"Lenders don't lend without a credit score. Yet construction still qualifies most of its trade partners with a stack of forms," said Michael Ho, Founder and CEO of Bespoke Metrics. "Making COMPASS the preferred prequalification solution inside Procore puts an independent risk rating at the center of how contractors choose who they build with. That's good for general contractors, and even better for the subcontractors who earn it."

About Bespoke Metrics

COMPASS by Bespoke Metrics is the largest global construction prequalification network, connecting 400+ general contractors and 150,000+ subcontractors across 33 countries and representing more than $1 trillion in annual construction volume. COMPASS applies a standardized approach to data collection, verification, and subcontractor assessment to manage risk across the construction supply chain. Subcontractors maintain one secure profile, control which General Contractors can access it, and generate their COMPASS Q Score (the Construction Credit Score) reflecting their operational expertise, financial capacity, and health and safety track record. Learn more at compass.bespokemetrics.com.

BELTSVILLE, Md., Oct. 15, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- VANKYO today announced the launch of the VANKYO Roku TV Leisure 3R smart mini projector that puts America's most-used streaming platform inside a portable barrel-shaped body with a 180° flip design.

Setup is the first problem the Leisure 3R solves. Roku TV is built in, so users stream without a separate stick or extra hardware. Its 180° flip structure adjusts the projection angle freely, letting the projector sit on a desk, a nightstand or a shelf without books to prop it up and without a tripod.

Its compact barrel body moves easily between a bedroom, a dorm room, a kids' room and a backyard.

Picture quality holds up where people actually watch. The Leisure 3R delivers 150 ANSI lumens of brightness, with native 720P resolution and support for 1080P content. Auto vertical keystone correction squares the image the moment the projector is placed. Wireless casting and Bluetooth let users send content from a phone, tablet or laptop and pair a speaker or headphones.

The entry-level projector category has spent years competing on the same spec sheet. The Leisure 3R is built around what happens after the box is open — whether a family can switch it on and start watching. Built-in Roku TV and the 180° flip design remove the two things that keep people from using a projector at all: extra accessories and awkward angles.

The Leisure 3R is available now at Walmart (US and Canada), Best Buy, Canadian Tire, and Meijer. Pricing may vary by retailer depending on special package options.

Key Specifications

  • Brightness: 150 ANSI lumens
  • Dimensions: 3.35 inches in diameter and 5.31 inches tall (6.89 inches with the base)
  • Weight: 15.5 ounces

VANKYO is a leading global brand dedicated to developing innovative and high-quality home entertainment projectors and related accessories. NEW YORK and LONDON, Oct. 15, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- YunoJuno, the Freelancer Management System (FMS) for global enterprises that powers the entire contingent worker lifecycle, has been named International Contractor Services Provider of the Year at the annual Contracting Awards. The win marks YunoJuno's third consecutive year leading the category, following awards in 2024 and again in 2025 as part of a double win for Best Contractor Innovation.

The award comes as more businesses build international teams of contractors to access specialist flexible skills and move faster than local hiring allows. As these teams operate across numerous jurisdictions, enterprises look for a partner that can carry the compliance responsibility. YunoJuno compliantly engages independent contractors and indemnifies the end client against classification risk, giving enterprises the confidence to scale their global contractor workforce.

"Winning this category three years running reflects a sustained and rapid investment in making international contracting simple for the businesses that depend on it," said Runar Reistrup, CEO of YunoJuno. "Every step in our roadmap this year has been built around removing the operational and legal complexity that enterprises normally face with a global contractor workforce, while managing and eliminating the risks involved."

International Contractor Services Provider of the Year recognizes excellence in supporting contractor engagement across countries, judged on compliance, scale, payment infrastructure and the overall experience delivered to both enterprise clients and the contractors they engage.

The judging panel specifically recognized YunoJuno's:

  • Global Reach and Scale: A network of more than 150,000 pre-vetted contractors across 165+ countries, connecting talent with over 12,000 businesses including numerous Fortune 500 enterprises.
  • Expanded W2 Capabilities: A fully managed US Employer of Record (EOR) solution bringing the US engagement lifecycle in-platform, removing the need for enterprises to navigate employment law, payroll and tax documentation across separate external systems.
  • Built-in Global Compliance: Automated worker classification workflows and indemnification coverage to help enterprises mitigate contractor misclassification risks.
  • Multi-Currency Payments: Auto-generated invoices and real-time status tracking, simplifying payment management for businesses and contractors.

"Managing compliance risk when engaging independent contractors internationally is one of the biggest challenges facing enterprise workforce leaders," said Joao Martires, Chief Operating Officer at YunoJuno. "Our focus has been on building the compliance processes and infrastructure that give enterprises complete visibility and control when engaging contractors globally. This award recognizes the unseen work our teams have put into making that possible."

The latest win follows a significant period of growth for YunoJuno, which achieved its first full year of profitability alongside 45% revenue growth in 2025, driven by international expansion and increasing enterprise demand.

YunoJuno was also recognized as the highest Leader and a Star Performer in Everest Group's 2026 PEAK Matrix® Assessment for Freelancer Engagement and Management Systems (FEMS). YunoJuno is the leading global end-to-end Freelancer Engagement and Management System (FEMS) that helps enterprises source, onboard, manage, and pay contractor talent with complete compliance and transparency. YunoJuno's AI-powered technology streamlines the entire contractor engagement process while mitigating compliance risks, currently serving 12,000 businesses and hundreds of thousands of independent contractors and freelancers globally.

BREA, Calif., Oct. 15, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- TickTalk, a leading innovator in kids' smartwatches and family communication platforms built around its mission of Communication First. Safety Always., announces the launch of TickTalk 6, its next-generation connected smartwatch for children ages 3 to 12. Designed to keep parents and children seamlessly connected through every drop-off, pickup and after-school moment, TickTalk 6 introduces TickTalk Radio™, a first-of-its-kind, fully parent-controlled music and wellness platform built specifically for kids.

While platforms like Spotify Kids, YouTube Kids, and the iHeartRadio Family app offer kid-focused audio experiences, TickTalk Radio takes a different approach, putting parents in greater control of what their children can access. TickTalk Radio is designed around curated, parent-approved station access, giving families more control over the listening experience. The result is age-appropriate entertainment that gives kids the freedom to enjoy music and audio content while keeping parents firmly in control of the experience.

"Caught in the parenting paradox, we built TickTalk Radio™ to solve a common parenting struggle: how to give kids access to music without opening the door to unrestricted streaming platforms," said Ying Gong, CEO of TickTalk Tech. "This gives children a fun, safe, and age-curated audio experience tailored to their growing independence, while giving parents total peace of mind through complete content controls, zero ads, and no open internet browsing."

Reimagining Kids' Audio: Curated by Age. Filtered by You. Made for Kids.

Unlike unrestricted, general-audience streaming services adapted for younger listeners, TickTalk Radio™ was built from the ground up for kids' devices in partnership with Feed.fm. Feed.fm provides the B2B music infrastructure that powers the end-to-end TickTalk Radio experience by combining pre-cleared, fully licensed major-label and science-backed wellness tracks, expert human curation, age-appropriate filtering, and turnkey streaming technology.

"Kids deserve the joy and discovery that comes with music, without requiring parents to open the door to a full consumer streaming experience," said Lauren Pufpaf, President and COO of Feed.fm. "TickTalk Radio shows what's possible when music is thoughtfully designed for a specific audience, combining licensed music, age-aware curation and parental controls in an experience built specifically for kids."

Key Features of TickTalk Radio™:

  • Built Specifically for Kids & Families: Purpose-built for young listeners rather than retrofitting general consumer streaming apps.
  • Tiered Age Curation & Higher Safety Standards: Developed in partnership with Feed.fm, the parent-approved stations are structured across three distinct developmental tiers: Junior (ages 3–5), Explorer (ages 6–9), and Tween (ages 9–12). Content moderation goes beyond standard clean/explicit labels by filtering for both language appropriateness and thematic maturity. Fresh content added regularly.
  • True Parental Control: Through the redesigned TickTalk Parent App, parents can manage or oversee preferences, preview any station, enable or disable individual channels, set daily listening duration limits, and adjust access as their child grows.
  • Entertainment + Daily Utility: Features popular, fully licensed major-label music alongside science-backed wellness tracks designed to help children cultivate healthy daily routines around calm, focus, sleep, and mindfulness.
  • Focus Mode Guardrails: Parents can activate Focus Mode during homework hours or bedtime, limiting audio access strictly to Wellness Stations so music supports routine without becoming a distraction.
  • Bounded & Ad-Free Experience: Operating in a completely closed system with zero ads, zero algorithmic social feeds, and no open search functionality, ensuring a safe and contained experience.
  • Music Distribution Innovation: Represents a groundbreaking distribution opportunity for the music industry, bringing fully licensed, major-label music to kids' connected wearables in a purpose-built environment, without exposing them to open streaming services.
  • Global Connectivity & Cloud Migration: Built-in eSIM activation and optional global travel connectivity ensure uninterrupted access to wellness streaming content anywhere families go.
  • Complete Family Ecosystem: TickTalk Radio™ operates seamlessly alongside the expanded hardware and software suite of the all-new TickTalk 6, integrating FaceTalk™ video calling, Real SMS, TickTalkie™ walkie-talkie communication, AI SmartPin™ location tracking, global eSIM connectivity, and free T-Cloud™ data migration for a secure, unified experience.

What Parents Are Saying:

"It's so helpful (and reassuring) as a parent to still have total control 'behind the scenes' while letting her explore her independence at a pace I feel comfortable with." — Shanna Wandmacher, Parent Tester

"The music selection is fun, diverse, and all three of my boys found stations they loved. The parental controls also give parents peace of mind and confidence that their children are listening to safe, age-appropriate content." — Samantha Archer, Parent Tester

Pricing and Availability

  • TickTalk Radio™ Subscription: Included as part of the TickTalk Wireless Premium plan, or available as an add-on service for $4.99/month (music availability subject to licensing and territory).



  • Exclusive Press Access & Media Preview Streaming: Members of the press can request access to stream TickTalk Radio™ via dedicated, password-protected web landing pages featuring embedded music players. This enables journalists and reviewers to experience the distinct Junior, Explorer, and Tween age tiers alongside dedicated wellness programming, thus getting the music experience without the need to test the device. 

About TickTalk

TickTalk is a leading kids' smartwatch and family communication platform designed to help children gain independence while helping families stay connected without giving kids a smartphone. 

Built around its mission, Communication First. Safety Always., TickTalk brings together safe calling and messaging, FaceTalk™ video calling, location and safety tools, parental controls, wireless connectivity, age-appropriate content, cloud services, protection, and family support through one connected ecosystem.

TickTalk products are designed specifically for children ages 3 to 12, with no social media, no open internet, and no unnecessary digital distractions. For more information, visit myticktalk.com or follow @myticktalk on Instagram.

Feed.fm's Branded Music Service powers white-label, in-app music for companies across kids and family, health, wellness, fitness, and other digital experiences. Learn more at www.feed.fm.

releases.title: Redwood Public Law Launches Sports, Arts & Entertainment Practice
releases.body:
New interdisciplinary practice brings together the firm's existing experience in public-private development, sports and entertainment transactions, NIL, cultural infrastructure and public law

OAKLAND, Calif., Oct. 14, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Redwood Public Law LLP today announced the formal launch of its Sports, Arts & Entertainment Practice, bringing together existing experience across public-private partnerships, sports and entertainment transactions, Name, Image and Likeness (NIL), cultural infrastructure and public law into a dedicated interdisciplinary practice.

The practice is led by Redwood partners Richard D. Pio Roda, Eric S. Casher and Steve Ngo, working alongside Senior Of Counsels Jade Y. Ramos and Neha Shah, whose sports and entertainment practice includes athlete representation, NIL, sponsorship and endorsement agreements, labor and employment issues, and transactions involving artists, creatives, and culture and entertainment organizations.

Together, the team advises public agencies, athletes, artists, creatives, non-profit organizations, and businesses on matters involving contracts and commercial agreements, stadium and venue development, sponsorships and endorsements, governance, public-private partnerships, cultural initiatives and related strategic initiatives.

"Sports, arts and entertainment are integral to and enhance civic life. They shape how communities see themselves, bring people together and serve as catalysts for economic development and community engagement and investment," said Richard D. Pio Roda, Partner and Co-Leader of Redwood's Sports, Arts & Entertainment Practice. "This practice formalizes work that Redwood and our attorneys are already doing and brings together complementary experience across public law, transactions, land use and development and the sports and entertainment industries to serve clients across the ecosystem."

Experience Across the Sports, Arts & Entertainment Ecosystem

Redwood's approach reflects the increasingly interconnected nature of sports, arts, entertainment and the public sector.

The firm currently serves as special counsel to the Oakland Acquisition Company, formerly the African American Sports & Entertainment Group, in connection with the acquisition and development of the Oakland-Alameda County Coliseum complex. Ramos previously led the legal team advising the Oakland-based development group in its acquisition effort, work Redwood has continued to advance.

Redwood attorneys also bring experience advising on major sports and entertainment developments throughout California, including the Waterfront Ballpark District at Howard Terminal in Oakland, the redevelopment of Hollywood Park in Inglewood, the ocV!BE mixed-use entertainment district and Honda Center in Anaheim, and DisneylandForward.

That experience encompasses public-private negotiations, real estate and land use, environmental review, development agreements, public finance, construction and public contracting, facility operations and other legal issues that arise throughout the lifecycle of major sports, entertainment and cultural projects.

The practice also extends beyond venues and development. Redwood advises athletes, artists, creatives, sports organizations and entertainment businesses on the legal and strategic infrastructure supporting their careers, organizations and ventures.

The Sports, Arts & Entertainment Practice includes:

  • Sports stadiums, entertainment venues and districts, including development, public contracting, land use, environmental review, public finance and facility operations;



  • Public-private partnerships among public agencies, developers, sports and entertainment organizations and nonprofit partners; 



  • NIL and athlete representation, including NIL agreements, institutional and collective arrangements, and strategic matters across collegiate and professional sports; 



  • Professional league and franchise matters, including ownership group representation, league negotiations and expansion bids;



  • Artist and creative representation, including agreements involving music, film, visual art, live performance and digital content; 



  • Contracts and commercial agreements, including talent, event, vendor, production, licensing and distribution agreements; 



  • Sponsorships, endorsements and brand partnerships, including naming rights, venue and event sponsorships, athlete and talent endorsements, brand ambassador agreements, co-branded content;



  • Intellectual property and brand protection, including trademark, copyright, licensing and rights of publicity; 



  • Media and broadcasting matters, including content, distribution and matters for public and community media organizations; 



  • Labor and employment matters for athletes, performers, creative professionals, and the organizations that employ them; 



  • Arts and cultural initiatives, including cultural facilities and districts, public art, murals, exhibitions, creative spaces and creative-economy programs; 



  • Governance, formation and organizational matters for sports, arts, entertainment and nonprofit entities, including foundations and mission-driven ventures;



  • Emerging technology issues affecting athletes, artists and creative businesses, including AI and digital content ownership; and

Government and regulatory matters affecting sports, arts, entertainment and cultural initiatives Ramos brings a distinctive perspective to the practice as both an attorney and former professional and NCAA Division I basketball player. Her experience includes advising collegiate athletes, sports organizations, artists and content creators. She also co-designed and co-instructed the inaugural Name, Image and Likeness legal clinic at UC Berkeley School of Law.

Pio Roda brings extensive experience in transactions, public-private partnerships, governance, public contracting, real estate and land use, while Casher's practice includes complex public agency, development, regulatory and strategic matters. Together with Ramos and attorneys across Redwood's practice areas, the team is structured to address matters that frequently cross traditional legal disciplines.

"Sports and entertainment are changing rapidly, particularly for athletes and creatives who are navigating increasingly complex commercial opportunities," said Jade Y. Ramos, Senior Of Counsel at Redwood Public Law. "Our goal is to help clients understand those opportunities, protect what they are building and create structures that allow their work and ideas to grow."

The launch reflects Redwood's broader commitment to advising clients on complex matters where public investment, private enterprise, culture and community converge.

Redwood will formally celebrate the launch of the Sports, Arts & Entertainment Practice with an event on October 16, 2026 in Oakland at the Historical Rotunda Building located at 300 Frank H. Ogawa Plaza beginning at 5:00pm, PST.

About Redwood Public Law LLP

Redwood Public Law LLP is a California public law firm advising public agencies, nonprofits, businesses and other organizations on complex legal, regulatory, transactional and governance matters. Redwood attorneys collectively serve as City Attorney for 16 California cities and as General Counsel to more than 30 special districts and nonprofit organizations. The firm maintains offices in Oakland and Sacramento and advises clients throughout California.

For more information about Redwood Public Law's Sports, Arts & Entertainment Practice, visit redwoodpubliclaw.com/sports-arts-entertainment.

releases.title: Houston's Kreative Media Launches the Kreative Velocity System
releases.body:
Texas digital marketing agency introduces a revenue-focused growth system connecting strategy, creative, paid media, SEO, AI visibility, and website performance.

HOUSTON, Oct. 14, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Kreative Media, a full-service digital marketing agency headquartered in Houston with locations across Texas, today announced the launch of the Kreative Velocity System, a performance-driven marketing framework designed to turn business goals and real performance data into smarter marketing decisions, strategic investments, and measurable business growth.

Most brands have marketing. Few have a system.

Rather than operating through disconnected campaigns or fixed strategies, the Kreative Velocity System continuously evaluates results, identifies opportunities, and shifts priorities toward the work with the greatest business potential. Each decision builds on previous performance, creating an adaptable approach to growth.

"Brands want to know what each dollar did," said Krista McDaniel, CEO of Kreative Media. "Our promise has always been bold creative, backed by data and built to produce results. The Kreative Velocity System is how we deliver on that consistently, so brands are built on purpose and every channel works toward the same number."

The methodology operates through four interconnected engines: Ad Velocity, optimizing paid media investment; Social Velocity, connecting audience insights with in-house creative production; SEO Velocity, expanding traditional and AI-powered search visibility through SEO, AEO, and GEO; and Site Velocity, prioritizing website improvements that turn traffic into business outcomes.

"Performance, creative, search visibility, and the website belong on the same page, tied to real revenue," said Karley Pines, Director of Performance Marketing at Kreative Media. "When they share one data foundation, every decision in one channel makes the next one smarter. That is what lets us scale spend with confidence and put creative time into what is proven to work."

As results evolve, the system adapts, using insights across disciplines to guide strategy, resource allocation, and future investments rather than restarting with each campaign.

The Kreative Velocity System is available to new and existing clients. Learn more at http://kreative-media.com/kreative-velocity-system/.

About Kreative Media

Kreative Media is a Texas-based, full-service digital marketing agency combining strategy, in-house creative production, paid advertising, SEO and AI search visibility, social media, branding, and web development to help businesses nationwide achieve measurable growth.

releases.title: Ashes of the Singularity II Launches November 10, 2026
releases.body:
The United Earth Forces take on the Post-Human Coalition and the AI Substrate in Stardock's massive-scale real-time strategy sequel

PLYMOUTH, Mich., Oct. 12, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- The war for the soul of the solar system is nigh as Stardock today announced that Ashes of the Singularity II will release November 10, 2026, on Steam. The sequel to the massive-scale real-time strategy game puts players in the middle of a war over humanity's future, fighting against enemies that have already surpassed it.

Set in the near future, Ashes of the Singularity II puts humanity in a fight for its own survival. The Post-Human Coalition, a faction of humans who have abandoned their physical bodies, has become the most technologically advanced power in the solar system. At the same time, a rogue artificial intelligence has built the AI Substrate, a machine civilization determined to secure its own future at any cost. Caught between them, humanity is losing ground.

The nations of Earth have set aside long-standing rivalries to form the United Earth Forces. Outmatched in technology and weaker unit for unit, the UEF must rely on what humanity still does best: large armies, disciplined infantry, and strategies drawn from thousands of years of military experience.

"We're grateful to every player who jumped in during Next Fest and our playtests. Ashes of the Singularity II is a better game because of them," said Adrian Wright, Vice President of Entertainment at Stardock. "On November 10, the fight to save humanity begins in massive-scale RTS battles we're eager for players to experience."

Players can lead humanity through the singleplayer campaign or take command of any of the three factions in instant action skirmish and multiplayer, each with its own units and unique style of play.

Since the Steam Next Fest demo and September's public multiplayer playtest, the development team has continued to improve gameplay, balance, performance, and multiplayer stability based on player feedback.

Ashes of the Singularity II Key Features:

  • Massive Armies, Vast Battlefields: Command thousands of units in real time across continent-sized maps, with Strategic Zoom letting players move seamlessly from orbital command to frontline combat.
  • Face Enemies of Our Own Making: Take command of the United Earth Forces, the Post-Human Coalition, or the AI Substrate, each with unique units, strategies, and philosophies.
  • Be the Commander: Victory comes from planning and logistics, not speed or reflexes, letting players focus on strategy rather than unit-by-unit control.
  • Unify Humanity Under Your Command: Lead humanity's United Earth Forces against Post-Human expansion and Substrate machinations in a story rooted in a near-future scenario of survival and restoration.
  • Endless Replayability: Generate custom battlefields and take on computer-controlled opponents designed by some of the industry's most experienced RTS developers.
  • Multiplayer, Competitive and Co-Op: Join friends or rivals online in head-to-head matches or team up in cooperative battles.
  • All-Terrain Warfare: Defeat humanity's foes on frozen lakes, treacherous mountain passes, and lava-filled chasms that change with persistent damage as the battle rages on. 

Ashes of the Singularity II will release on November 10, 2026. The standard edition will be available at launch for $39.99; with a premium edition that includes the game, first three DLC packs and soundtrack for $69.99. Both editions will carry a special 20% launch discount from Nov. 10-17 and be available on Steam, directly through Stardock, or via other partners. For more information on Ashes II, visit www.ashesofthesingularity.com.

releases.title: PlanetiQ Launches GNOMES-10, Expanding High-Precision GNSS Radio Occultation Constellation
releases.body:
New GNSS-RO satellite launch advances PlanetiQ's growing constellation of high-precision atmospheric and ionospheric sensors

GOLDEN, Colo., Oct. 14, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- PlanetiQ's GNOMES-10 satellite successfully launched October 1 at 11:32 a.m. PDT aboard SpaceX's Transporter-18 mission from Vandenberg Space Force Base, marking another major step in the company's expansion of its global GNSS radio occultation (GNSS-RO) constellation. Following launch, PlanetiQ's partner ground stations quickly established first contact with GNOMES-10, and spacecraft commissioning began immediately.

"...our data supports weather applications by measuring Earth's atmospheric and ionospheric state," said Chris McCormick

GNOMES-10 Carries PlanetiQ's Fourth-Generation Pyxis Receiver

GNOMES-10 carries PlanetiQ's fourth-generation Pyxis GNSS-RO receiver, which was built and tested at PlanetiQ's facility in Golden, Colorado. Pyxis is engineered to capture exceptionally high-quality GNSS signals for radio occultation measurements. Its combination of high signal-to-noise ratio (SNR), high-rate signal sampling, precise timing, and advanced antenna design enables PlanetiQ to retrieve highly detailed atmospheric profiles from each radio occultation event.

Pyxis incorporates a high-accuracy oscillator and PlanetiQ's bespoke satellite antenna design, both engineered to maximize the information captured from each GNSS-RO observation. These capabilities provide detailed measurements of atmospheric structure, including in the lower troposphere and ionosphere.

"Experiencing the launch firsthand is a reflection of, and a tremendous appreciation for, all the excellent hard work by everyone involved, including our employees, suppliers, and customers," said Chris McCormick, Founder, President and Chairman of PlanetiQ. "We are proud that our data supports weather applications by measuring Earth's atmospheric and ionospheric state and furthering our knowledge of Earth's dynamic weather patterns."

Simultaneous GNSS Tracking Creates More RO Opportunities

PlanetiQ satellites simultaneously track signals from all four major GNSS constellations: GPS, BeiDou, GLONASS, and Galileo. Each satellite also uses a wide ±75-degree limb-sounding field of view.

By tracking multiple GNSS constellations simultaneously and observing signals across a wide field of view, PlanetiQ satellites can observe more GNSS transmitters at the same time. This creates more opportunities for radio occultation measurements and enables PlanetiQ to produce more GNSS-RO observations per hour than other commercial RO constellations.

The resulting observations provide weather models and other users with highly detailed information about atmospheric structure. PlanetiQ's high-SNR measurements are particularly valuable for resolving features in the lower troposphere, where atmospheric conditions can change rapidly and where conventional satellite observations can be challenging.

GNOMES-11 to Add Lower-Inclination GNSS-RO Observations

PlanetiQ plans to launch GNOMES-11 later this month, carrying the same fourth-generation Pyxis receiver as GNOMES-10. The addition of GNOMES-10 and GNOMES-11 is part of PlanetiQ's ongoing effort to expand the availability, quality, and diversity of commercial GNSS-RO observations for weather forecasting, space weather, and other mission-critical applications.

About PlanetiQ

PlanetiQ provides the highest-quality GNSS radio occultation (RO) data available from a commercial constellation of satellites, offering unmatched temporal and spatial resolution. The data drive accurate, high-impact weather and climate forecast models, helping improve Numerical Weather Prediction and AI forecasts, safeguard lives and property from severe weather. PlanetiQ is a space-tech company that serves the most mission-critical government, defense, and industry leaders, including international weather agencies, enabling more resilient operations across sectors. Founded in 2015 and privately owned, PlanetiQ designs, builds, and operates the preeminent commercial constellation of GNSS-RO satellites, setting the standard for precision and reliability in atmospheric monitoring. For more information, visit PlanetiQ.

releases.title: Local Media Consortium Launches SMB AI Study
releases.body:
Research initiative under LMC's AI Accelerator will provide benchmarking insights for small and mid-sized businesses, help local media companies strengthen relationships with local advertisers

NEW YORK, Oct. 13, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- The Local Media Consortium (LMC) today announced the launch of its SMB AI Benchmarking Study, a research initiative presented by its Digital On-Demand Services (DODS) division in partnership with Borrell Associates. The second initiative under LMC's recently launched AI Accelerator for Local Media program, the study will examine how small and mid-sized businesses are using artificial intelligence and navigating a rapidly changing business environment. Findings will provide participating SMBs with valuable benchmarking data while helping local media organizations better understand and support local advertisers.

The research comes at a pivotal moment for local media organizations. Data from the 2026 LMC Industry Insights Survey found that the percentage of publishers identifying agency services as a top priority  declined by 80% year over year, highlighting the need for new ways to serve local advertisers and build sustainable revenue streams. The study is designed to help publishers better understand how businesses perceive, adopt and invest in AI while identifying opportunities to provide more valuable guidance, services and support.

Participating businesses from industries ranging from healthcare and professional services to retail, hospitality and home services will gain access to benchmarking insights that compare local findings with broader regional and national trends. Depending on participation levels, businesses may also be able to compare results within specific industries and local markets. Initial aggregated findings are expected in November 2026.

"Small and mid-sized businesses are being asked to make important decisions about marketing, technology and AI at a pace that is often difficult to keep up with," said Fran Wills, CEO of the LMC. "Research suggests concerns about the accuracy of AI-generated information remain widespread among small businesses, reinforcing the need for trusted local partners who understand their markets and can help separate hype from reality. This study will help us better understand what local businesses need most and identify new ways local media organizations can support their growth and success."

The study is expected to identify opportunities for local media organizations to expand the services and expertise they provide to advertisers while deepening their role as trusted advisors. Findings will help publishers better understand how businesses are navigating AI, how AI impacts marketing and technology decisions and where they need additional support.

"I don't think anyone will disagree that AI is already having a profound effect on the way we conduct business. What's still a mystery is how deep the seismic shift is being felt among those very busy, very practical SMBs," said Gordon Borrell, CEO of Borrell Associates. "Past surveys have shown they're yearning for a trusted advisor to help them navigate the complex marketing world. This survey will help us learn whether AI has begun filling that role, and how deeply AI may already be embedded in their marketing activities. I'm confident it will uncover early opportunities for local media companies to complement their migration toward AI adoption."

Participating businesses will have the opportunity to receive a summary of the findings and contribute to one of the most comprehensive studies examining the intersection of AI, advertising and local business growth. The findings will help inform future products, services, educational resources and support programs that strengthen relationships between local media organizations and the businesses they serve.

The SMB AI in Benchmarking Study is part of the Local Media Consortium's AI Accelerator, a broader effort by the LMC and its Digital On-Demand Services (DODS) division to help local media organizations identify new opportunities for growth, strengthen advertiser relationships and develop solutions that meet evolving market needs. The initiative is supported through funding from the John S. and James L. Knight Foundation as part of the News Media Help Desk, an online resource created by the LMC and the Reynolds Journalism Institute to support the long-term sustainability of local media.

About the Local Media Consortium

The Local Media Consortium delivers more than $60 million in annual economic value through digital partnerships and strategic initiatives on behalf of more than 150 local media companies in top markets across the United States, Canada and Puerto Rico, and includes more than 5,000 newspaper, radio, TV and online-only news outlets. By harnessing the combined volume and scale of its members, the LMC reduces costs and increases revenue with technology and service providers. The aggregated LMC audience footprint spans 200 million unique monthly visitors, and its member companies serve more than nine billion pageviews to consumers.

releases.title: Grafine Partners and Atlantic Ridge Capital to Acquire Paragon Films
releases.body:
Investment builds on Grafine and Atlantic Ridge's strategic partnership, bringing together deep industrial technology expertise, differentiated investment capabilities and institutional capital.

NEW YORK, Oct. 13, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Grafine Partners ("Grafine") and Atlantic Ridge Capital ("Atlantic Ridge") today announced that they have partnered to acquire Paragon Films ("Paragon" or the "Company") in a transaction valued at approximately $900 million. Atlantic Ridge will lead the investment and work closely with Paragon's management team to drive the Company's next phase of growth. The transaction is expected to close in the fourth quarter of 2026.

Paragon, founded in 1988 and headquartered in Broken Arrow, Oklahoma, manufactures technologically advanced films used to secure and protect products during storage and transit. Its proprietary formulations and manufacturing processes allow customers to achieve superior load containment with thinner-gauge films. The Company's Thinner. Stronger. Greener.® approach combines product performance with 20% to 30% cost savings while using 20% to 40% less film, reducing material use and waste for customers. The Company serves more than 20,000 end users in the resilient and growing food and beverage, consumer products, e-commerce, retail and industrial endmarkets.

"Our underwriting gave us strong conviction in Paragon's business and long-term growth potential," said Elizabeth Weymouth, Founder and Managing Partner of Grafine Partners. "The Company has many of the characteristics we look for in an investment: a differentiated competitive position, durable demand, strong fundamentals and multiple avenues for value creation. The opportunity exemplifies the strength of our investment model in action, combining the deep sector expertise of our investment partners with Grafine's own investment capabilities and institutional capital."

"Paragon has built a differentiated business through a relentless focus on product performance, innovation and its customers," said Eytan Tigay, Founder and Managing Partner of Atlantic Ridge Capital. "We see significant opportunity to build on that foundation and are excited to partner with Grafine on this investment. Grafine has been a strategic partner since our inception, and its investment expertise, capital and long-term perspective have been instrumental in bringing this transaction together."

The transaction represents an important milestone in Grafine's strategic partnership with Atlantic Ridge, which began when Grafine became an early institutional partner and investor in Atlantic Ridge's inaugural fund.

About Grafine Partners

Grafine Partners is a principal investment firm focused on generating private markets alpha through differentiated access and disciplined underwriting in the lower middle and middle market segments of private equity, where the firm believes the greatest potential for outperformance exists. Grafine combines its own investment expertise and flexible institutional capital with a differentiated sourcing network to invest directly in businesses and partner with experienced sector-specialist investors. A core element of Grafine's strategy is backing accomplished private equity investors as they launch their own firms, creating long-term strategic partnerships that expand the firm's access to compelling investment opportunities. For more information, please visit www.grafine.com.

About Atlantic Ridge Capital

Founded by industry veteran Eytan Tigay, Atlantic Ridge Capital is a New York-based private equity firm focused on high-quality middlemarket businesses, primarily within the industrial technology sector. The firm seeks companies with differentiated competitive positions and attractive long-term growth drivers. Working with proven management teams, Atlantic Ridge applies a systematic approach to business building, bringing operational resources, including advanced digital and artificial intelligence capabilities, to scale, improve and modernize their businesses. For more information, visit www.atlanticridgecapital.com.

About Paragon Films

Founded in 1988 and headquartered in Broken Arrow, Oklahoma, Paragon Films is a leader in ultra-high-performance stretch film focused on advancing sustainability through innovation. Sustainability Without Sacrifice™ reflects its approach to designing films that balance durability and cost-effective packaging while helping customers achieve their sustainability goals. Learn more at www.paragonfilms.com.

NEW YORK, Oct. 12, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- B. Riley Securities, Inc., a leading full-service investment bank, today announced that Michael Masiuk has joined the firm's Investment Banking team as Managing Director, based in New York.

Michael Masiuk joins B. Riley Securities as Managing Director to Expand Technology, Media and Sports Advisory

Mr. Masiuk expands B. Riley Securities' growth and private capital, M&A advisory, and proprietary deal origination capabilities, deepening coverage of corporate and financial sponsor clients in the sports, media, and technology sectors.

"Michael brings deep relationships with founders, operators, and institutional investors, along with extensive experience across public and private capital markets," said Andy Moore, CEO of B. Riley Securities. "His expertise in sports, media, and technology further fortifies our platform, and his addition reflects our commitment to adding senior talent across high-growth sectors."

Mr. Masiuk brings over 25 years of experience across investment banking, hedge funds, and the entertainment industry, with specialized expertise in sports, media, and technology. He possesses a strong track record of originating and executing transactions across public and private capital markets, including growth equity, crossover rounds, and buyouts. His work bridges private growth-stage capital and public market execution, and he has built a proprietary pipeline through long-standing relationships with key industry stakeholders and institutional backers.

"Companies across the sports, media, and technology landscape increasingly need a partner who understands both private growth capital and the public markets," said Mr. Masiuk. "B. Riley Securities' institutional platform enables us to take relationships with founders and investors from first conversation through execution, whether a growth round, a crossover, or a path to the public markets."

Throughout his career, Mr. Masiuk has advised public and private companies on equity, debt, and hybrid financings, and his advisory work spans multiple professional sports leagues and franchises, public and private media companies, and growth-stage technology businesses transitioning to the public markets. He joins from Clear Street, where he was a Managing Director focused on proprietary deal origination, and previously served as a Managing Director at Cantor Fitzgerald and as a partner at The Schottenfeld Group. He holds a B.A. from Saint Anselm College.

releases.title: Wondershare Filmora 16 Launches to Make Professional Video Creation More Accessible with AI
releases.body:
VANCOUVER, BC, Oct. 9, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Wondershare Filmora, a flagship video creativity software developed by Wondershare, has officially launched its new version, Filmora 16. Built around the new "Edit as an Expert with Filmora & AI" positioning, Filmora 16 brings a broad range of AI-powered and professional capabilities designed to reduce tedious editing work, give creators greater control, and make professional creativity more accessible.

With this major version, Wondershare Filmora extends its capabilities across the entire video creation workflow, from understanding source material and taking control of the edit to shaping creative expression and delivering finished content. Highlights include AI Media Analysis for smarter footage understanding, Camera Tracking and Color Mask for more precise editing, and 360° Video Reframing for greater creative flexibility. Alongside a wider range of new and upgraded capabilities, Filmora V16 is designed for aspiring and emerging video creators, including YouTube creators and small marketing teams, helping them create more ambitious content with less complexity.

Understand Every Source

Video creation starts with understanding what you have to work with. Footage can come from different devices and formats, and creators need to quickly identify what each asset contains before deciding what belongs in the final edit. Filmora 16 makes this first stage easier by bringing source material into one editing workflow while helping creators analyze, organize, and find the content they need.

Key capabilities:

  • AI Media Analysis & Smart Media Bin — AI Media Analysis helps creators understand video and image assets by identifying key visual content and generating searchable tags, descriptions, and editing suggestions. The analyzed assets can then be organized in Smart Media Bin, making it easier to browse, filter, and locate useful footage across larger media libraries.
  • Multi-source Recording — Records screen, camera, microphone, and system audio as separate sources that can move directly into the editing timeline.
  • Game Recording — Provides a dedicated recording mode for supported game windows, with the captured footage ready for editing in Filmora.

Take Professional Control

Once the source material is understood, creators need precise control over how it appears and behaves in the frame. Professional editing often involves following moving subjects, isolating specific areas, managing layers, or adjusting color. Filmora 16 brings these controls into a more accessible editing workflow, making complex visual adjustments easier to manage without adding unnecessary complexity.

Key capabilities:

  • Camera Tracking — Tracks a head, body, or custom area and enables camera-following effects without relying on complex manual keyframing.
  • Color Mask — Applies color adjustments to selected areas of a frame, giving creators more precise control over local color treatment.
  • Track Matte — Uses one layer to control the visible area of another, enabling more flexible compositing effects.
  • Auto Color — Automatically improves common color and exposure issues.

Shape Your Creative Vision

With the footage organized and the edit under control, creators can shape how their content looks, moves, and communicates. Filmora 16 expands the creative possibilities across visual movement, text, captions, and immersive footage, giving creators more ways to develop a distinct visual style and bring their ideas to the screen.

Key capabilities:

  • Video Animation — Provides In, Out, and Combo animations with more control over movement within a clip, supporting more flexible visual rhythm and transitions.
  • 360° Video Reframing — Lets creators reframe 360° footage, adjust viewing angles, and use keyframes and camera-movement presets to create dynamic shots.
  • Automatic Correction — Identifies common transcription errors and provides correction suggestions, while allowing repeated errors to be corrected together and terms to be added to a personal dictionary.
  • Subtitle Track — Separates subtitle content into dedicated tracks for more structured editing, styling, export, and multilingual management.
  • Dynamic Caption — Applies visual caption styles and templates to help spoken content become part of the video's visual rhythm.
  • Keyframe Motion Blur — Helps animated elements move more naturally by adding blur to keyframed motion.

Deliver With Less Friction

The final stage of video creation often involves more than exporting a single finished file. Projects may need to move between editing tools, versions may need to be prepared for different uses, and content may need to move across devices. Filmora 16 streamlines these final steps, making it easier to export, transfer, and continue working wherever the content needs to go.

Key capabilities:

  • XML Import/Export — Brings compatible timeline structures into Filmora and exports projects for basic cross-software editing workflows.
  • Batch Export — Processes multiple export tasks together, reducing repetitive manual work when several versions are needed.

For teams working on more structured commercial and branded video projects, Wondershare also offers Filmora.TV, a browser-based AI creative studio that brings visual planning, AI content generation, editing, and team collaboration together in one workspace. The platform is designed for agencies, brand teams, and commercial creators who need a connected workflow from initial concept to production-ready video. More information is available at Filmora.TV.

"AI is changing what is possible in video creation," said Christy Wu, Vice President at Wondershare. "Filmora 16 reflects our continued investment in making professional creative capabilities more intuitive and accessible, giving creators more room to focus on their ideas and their craft. We believe technology should expand the possibilities of creativity, and we are committed to building products that help more people create, communicate, and bring their ideas into the world."

Wondershare Filmora 16 is now available for creators looking to bring more professional control and creative flexibility into their video workflows. To learn more and experience the latest version, visit Wondershare Filmora.

About Filmora

releases.title: Guideline Ends the Media Plan Re-Entry Bottleneck with Launch of New AI Ingestion Agent
releases.body:
The new agent reads media plan spreadsheets in any format and turns them into clean, governed data in seconds.

NEW YORK, Oct. 9, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Guideline, a global provider of ad intelligence and media plan management solutions, today launched the AI Ingestion Agent in its Media Plan Management platform. The agent takes the spreadsheet media plans agencies and brands already use and turns them into structured, governed data in seconds.

Most media plans still start in a spreadsheet, and every agency, team, market and client lays them out differently. Getting a plan into a system of record has meant re-entering it by hand, which takes time, introduces errors, and delays the moment when finance, leadership and operations teams can see and act on the plan. The AI Ingestion Agent removes that manual step without requiring teams to change how they build plans.

With the AI Ingestion Agent, planning teams can:

  • Start from their existing file. Upload an Excel or CSV file to create a new plan.
  • Automate field mapping. The agent reads each column and suggests how it maps to the customer's plan templates and fields.
  • Review before anything is saved. Fields the agent is less certain about are flagged, and nothing is committed until the planner confirms it.
  • Use the plan right away. Once confirmed, the plan is structured data that can be used for reporting, budget tracking and actuals reconciliation.

Uploaded files are validated so that only supported plan formats are processed, and customer plan data is not used to train AI models. Each upload is saved as a new plan version rather than overwriting earlier work, so every change can be traced. This new product capability ships with enterprise controls. It is opt-in and enabled per customer. This first release creates new plans from spreadsheets; updating existing plans and bulk-importing historical ones will follow.

"Every customer's spreadsheet looks different, and for years that has been the hardest part of getting plans into a system of record," said Vincent Mifsud, Chief Executive Officer at Guideline. "The sooner a plan becomes governed data, the sooner it can be measured, reconciled and improved. That is central to making Media Plan Management the trusted source of truth for the more than $300 billion in media budgets our customers manage with us."

"Planners shouldn't have to retype a plan to get it into a governed platform," said Steve Silvers, Chief Product Officer at Guideline. "The agent works with the files teams already use and handles the mapping for them. We built it to save planners time without taking decisions out of their hands."

Availability: The AI Ingestion Agent is available now for enterprise customers. To learn more or schedule a demo, contact sales@guideline.ai or visit www.guideline.ai.

About Guideline

Guideline is a global provider of ad intelligence and media plan management technology for the world's leading brands, agencies, media owners and investors. Its solutions help enterprises understand advertising markets, manage media plans and make more informed decisions across the buying and selling ecosystem. Guideline's media plan management solutions support more than $300 billion in managed media budgets across more than 60,000 active media plans and 10,000+ monthly users. Its proprietary spend and pricing data represents approximately $200 billion in annual media investment across 65 countries worldwide.

For more information, visit www.guideline.ai.

releases.title: Parents Anonymous® Launches Breaking the Stigma with Dr. Lisa Podcast on Parent and Youth Mental Health on World Mental Health Day
releases.body:
First episode premieres Saturday, October 10, 2026, on World Mental Health Day

LOS ANGELES, Oct. 9, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Parents Anonymous, Inc. today announced the launch of Breaking the Stigma with Dr. Lisa, a new podcast featuring honest conversations about the strengths and challenges parents and young people face every day. Hosted by Parents Anonymous President and CEO Dr. Lisa Pion-Berlin, the podcast is founded on one core belief: Asking for Help is a Sign of Strength®.

Breaking the Stigma with Dr. Lisa premieres Saturday, Oct. 10, on World Mental Health Day. Each episode will feature parents, young people and advocates sharing firsthand experiences with mental health, family pressures and the decision to reach out for support.

"Too many parents, children and youth feel like they have to hide what they are going through or wait until things get worse before reaching out," Dr. Lisa Pion-Berlin said. "This podcast is about making those conversations more honest, more visible and more human. If even one person hears these stories and realizes they are not alone, that matters."

The first episode, "When Your Child Is Struggling: Finding Strength in Asking for Help," features Aurora, a Latina mother of two sharing her family's experience navigating her daughter's anxiety and panic attacks.

Upcoming episodes will explore parenting a child with special needs while navigating family loss; bullying, social media and youth mental health; the pressures of caring for aging parents and an adult child at the same time; substance use and recovery; and the power of parent leadership.

While many parenting and mental health podcasts focus primarily on expert interviews, commentary or advice, Breaking the Stigma with Dr. Lisa takes a story-led approach. Parents, young people and advocates speak directly about what they experienced, how those challenges affected their daily lives, why asking for help felt difficult and what changed when someone listened without judgment. The series spans a range of family experiences, giving parents, children and youth more opportunities to hear stories that reflect their own lives. The conversations also reinforce that needing support does not make someone weak and that reaching out is a courageous first step.

Following the Oct. 10 premiere, additional episodes will be released monthly. Listeners can follow Breaking the Stigma with Dr. Lisa on YouTube, Apple Podcasts, Spotify and other major podcast platforms.

Parents, children and youth seeking emotional support can call or text the National Parent & Youth Helpline™ at 855-427-2736 or start a live chat at NationalParentYouthHelpline.org. Support is available at no cost, 24 hours a day, seven days a week with no blame and shame.

About Parents Anonymous, Inc.

Parents Anonymous® is a leader in evidence-based programs dedicated to building on the strengths of parents, children and youth to foster family and community well-being. Parents Anonymous Weekly Adult and Children & Youth Groups is recognized by The Federal Title IV-E Prevention Clearinghouse as proven to Effectively Improve Parenting, Enhance Mental Health and Reduce Substance Abuse while Ensuring Child Safety for parents, children and youth of all ages. The organization also operates the National Parent & Youth Helpline™ and California Parent & Youth Helpline®, the only positive research-backed, no-cost helpline nationwide. Emotional support is provided by trained counselors, 24 hours a day, 7 days a week by calling/texting 1-855-427-2736 or through live chat at nationalparentyouthhelpline.org and caparentyouthhelpline.org.

releases.title: Tractor Named to the 2026 Fortune Best Workplaces in Manufacturing & Production™ List
releases.body:
Farmer-founded, employee-owned beverage company ranks No. 34 among small and medium workplaces

DENVER, Oct. 9, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Tractor Beverage Company has been named to the 2026 Fortune Best Workplaces in Manufacturing & Production™ list, ranking No. 34 in the small and medium company category. Produced by Great Place To Work®, the list recognizes companies based on employees' feedback about their workplace experience.

For Tractor, the recognition celebrates the people who bring its "soil and soul" ethos to life and carry forward its Founder's Intent: to make organic beverages more accessible and to help build a better food system rooted in healthier soil. It reflects the care, creativity, and commitment employees bring to their work and to one another.

That spirit is at the heart of Tractor's "business as unusual" ethos: building a company where care for people, commitment to organic agriculture and healthier soil are part of the same purpose. Fully remote since day one, Tractor gives employees flexibility in where they work while creating shared experiences that connect them to the land and to one another.

Each team member receives financial support for a community-supported agriculture (CSA) membership, bringing the company's commitment to farmers into everyday life. Through Farm Camp, employees spend time on the farm, deepening their understanding of the soil, the people who tend it and the work behind the ingredients in Tractor's beverages.

"The people at Tractor are the heart of this company," said Kevin Sherman, CEO of Tractor Beverage Company. "They bring curiosity, conviction and care to the work every day. This recognition belongs to them, and it reminds us of our responsibility to keep building a company where people feel valued and proud of what we're growing together."

The ranking follows Tractor's July 2025 employee survey through Great Place To Work. The assessment gave employees an opportunity to share their experiences and helped inform the company's recognition on the 2026 list.

"Culture grows through the everyday ways we show up for one another," said John Martin, Chief People and Culture Officer at Tractor Beverage Company. "It's listening, making room for different perspectives, and recognizing that people bring their whole lives to work. Hearing directly from our team makes this honor especially meaningful and gives us a foundation to keep learning and growing together."

Great Place To Work evaluates confidential employee feedback on trust, respect, fairness and other aspects of workplace culture. The small and medium category includes eligible companies with 10 to 999 employees in the United States.

The Fortune recognition adds to a growing record of honors for Tractor's culture, innovation and growth. Tractor was named to Fast Company's 2025 Flexible Workplaces for Innovation list, part of its annual Best Workplaces for Innovators program, recognizing the company's remote culture and Farm Camp immersion. Tractor also earned a place on the Inc. 5000 list of America's fastest-growing private companies for a fifth consecutive year in 2026. Its broader innovation honors include Fast Company's World Changing Ideas recognition for the Organic Impact Tracker in 2024 and Tractor Beam in 2026, alongside NEXTY and FABI awards for Haymaker, its organic sparkling apple cider vinegar tonic.

To view the full list, visit Great Place To Work.

About Tractor Beverage Company

Farmer-founded and employee-owned, Tractor is built on the belief that a better food system starts with the land—and the people who care for it. Every beverage is crafted with certified organic ingredients and a commitment to supporting soil health. We're here to make drinks that taste great, deliver real impact, and help raise awareness for regenerative practices that nourish both the earth and the communities it sustains. Through the Farmhand Foundation, we support growers in their transition to organic farming and work to expand the domestic supply chain, ensuring farmers prosper, ecosystems thrive, and the regenerative organic market continues to grow. And with our Organic Impact Tracker, we provide unprecedented transparency into the environmental benefits of organic sourcing, helping partners see the measurable difference every sip makes.

For more information, visit drinktractor.com or follow @drinktractor on Instagram.
